notes.title: Hotfix June 30th
notes.content: We’re rolling out a new Forza Motorsport hotfix on Xbox Series X|S and PC that includes a few Career mode fixes alongside a permanent ABCS Multi-Class Series in Featured Multiplayer in response to your feedback. Here are the release notes: [url=https://t.co/Te6ZPMGN7Z https://t.co/GTRn4OHJXR]https://t.co/Te6ZPMGN7Z https://t.co/GTRn4OHJXR[/url]

notes.title: Forza Motorsport – IndyCar and Champions Cup
notes.content:
[p]Experience intense open-wheel racing in IndyCars and enter the Champions Cup, a free extension to Career mode.[/p][p]First and foremost, thank you for celebrating 20 Years of Forza Motorsport with us. Our 20th Anniversary milestone was as much about you as it is our games. We made that update because we wanted to reignite the fun and excitement from the memories you have racing and drifting alongside your friends at Fujimi Kaido in Forza Motorsport 3 and 4.[/p][p]Over the past 20 years, so many of you have come together and created lasting friendships through Forza Motorsport. That’s why we introduced Meetups, a place for you to celebrate car culture and motorsports, with the community. We hope you continue to participate in Meetups and forge new friendships with players who are just as passionate about cars and racing as you are.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/356fdaf750fecaeaf3f591925fc30db036c63c4f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]With all of that said, let’s take a look at the new content and features that you will experience with Forza Motorsport Update 21, which introduces the latest generation of IndyCars to the Showroom, a new, permanent Career called the Champions Cup, and sees the return of previously released Featured Tours and reward cars starting July 3.[/p][p]Show off your car building skills in Open Division Rivals, join Top Speed and Cycled Ovals Meetups, and re-order the starting positions of competitors with Manual Grid Ordering in Private Multiplayer.[/p][p]With Update 21, both the 2025 Chevrolet IndyCar and 2025 Honda IndyCar are being added to the Showroom and can be acquired with in-game credits. These new-to-Motorsport, open-wheel racers will also be discounted through July 2, 2025.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/d58ef1c5524449f1caaaf000f482a5aa89094e16.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Between IndyCar, the Champions Cup in Career, and other new features, there’s a lot to check out. We’ve broken this blog down into categories to help you find the details that are most important to you. Select any of the topics below to quickly jump to that section:[/p][list][*][p][b][u][url="https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-21#releasenotes"]Update 21 Release Notes[/url][/u][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][u][url="https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-21#indycar"]New Cars – IndyCar[/url][/u][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][u][url="https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-21#career"]Racecar Career – Champions Cup[/url][/u][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][u][url="https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-21#featuredtours"]Featured Tours and Reward Cars[/url][/u][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][u][url="https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-21#opentour"]Expanded Open Tour[/url][/u][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][u][url="https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-21#rivals"]Open Division Rivals[/url][/u][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][u][url="https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-21#manualgrid"]Manual Grid Ordering[/url][/u][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][u][url="https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-21#meetups"]New Public Meetups[/url][/u][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][u][url="https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-21#multiplayer"]Multiplayer Events[/url][/u][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b][u][url="https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-21#challenges"]Challenge Hub[/url][/u][/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Be sure to stay informed about the latest Forza news and updates by [b][u][url="https://forza.net/newsletter"]signing up for the Forza Newsletter[/url][/u][/b]. Follow our [b]@ForzaMotorsport[/b] channels on [b][u][url="https://www.facebook.com/forzamotorsport/"]Facebook[/url][/u][/b], [b][u][url="https://www.instagram.com/forzamotorsport/"]Instagram[/url][/u][/b], [b][u][url="https://www.youtube.com/@Forza"]YouTube[/url][/u][/b], [b][u][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@forzamotorsport"]TikTok[/url][/u][/b], and [b][u][url="https://twitter.com/ForzaMotorsport"]X (formerly Twitter)[/url][/u][/b] where you can share your photos, videos, liveries and tunes for a chance to be highlighted. Meet and chat with like-minded Motorsport players in our community and keep up to date with events in [b][u][url="https://discord.gg/forza"]our Forza Discord server[/url][/u][/b].[/p][h2][b]Game Improvements and Release Notes[/b][/h2][p]Forza Motorsport Update 21 rolls out for download starting Monday, June 16 on Xbox Series X|S and PC via the Microsoft Store and Steam. Multiplayer and Rivals events will be refreshed Wednesday, June 18 starting at 5:00 PM PT (12:00 AM UTC on Thursday, June 19).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/eac8f8c2c789bdc4c7d5140fee313f675aa4159a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Below is an overview of the changes and improvements included with Update 21:[/p][list][*][p]Featured Multiplayer has been reorganized, incorporating player feedback, with the goal of providing players with even more event variety. [b][u][url="https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-21#multiplayer"]Click here for a rundown of these changes.[/url][/u][/b][/p][/*][*][p]We’ve implemented BoP Spec changes to the Forza GT2, Forza GT3, Forza Touring Car, and Forza Proto-H divisions with help from participants in the Forza Insiders Program. [b][u][url="https://aka.ms/FMUpdate21RN"]See the release notes for an overview of the adjustments that have been made.[/url][/u][/b][/p][/*][*][p]The Challenge Hub menu has been reorganized to more effectively communicate where rewards can be earned as well as the type of rewards available to unlock.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve fixed an issue for players using the Fanatec DD2 racing wheel that would assign the peripheral an incorrect mapping profile.[/p][/*][*][p]All Builders Cup Tours are now immediately unlocked, which means you no longer need to complete the Modern Tour to access the 3 other Builders Cup Tours. In addition, select Builders Cup Series have been updated to feature additional eligible cars and post-launch tracks. A detailed overview of these changes has been included in the release notes.[/p][/*][*][p]There are also numerous fixes to AI behavior and competitiveness in single-player racing.[/p][/*][/list][p][b][u][url="https://aka.ms/FMUpdate21RN"]Check out the Update 21 release notes on our Forza Support site for a full overview of the fixes, improvements and other changes that are included with this release.[/url][/u][/b][/p][h2][b]Compete with IndyCar in Intense Open-Wheel Racing[/b][/h2][p]IndyCar has returned to Forza Motorsport! Get behind the wheel of the latest generation of IndyCars and experience intense open-wheel racing.[/p][p]Go to the Showroom and add the new-to-Motorsport 2025 Chevrolet IndyCar and 2025 Honda IndyCar to your garage today. Both cars will permanently be available in the game using Credits, and you can even get them discounted until July 2, 2025.[/p][p]Jump into the all-new IndyCar Series in Featured Multiplayer or check out the IndyCar Series in the Thunder Tour in the new Champions Cup Career! Step into the world of high-speed excitement in these premier open-wheel racing series, where precision, power, and passion collide on the track.[/p][p]The IndyCar Series in Featured Multiplayer will cycle between oval track layouts and GP/road layouts, with the appropriate aero parts being automatically swapped depending on the track type.[/p][p]In addition, a new ‘Spec Division – IndyCar' Rivals event has been added to the Spec Division Rivals category where you can attempt to set your fastest lap times at the world-famous Brickyard circuit at Indianapolis Motor Speedway.[/p][h2][b]Introducing Champions Cup, Your New Racing Career[/b][/h2][p]New permanent racecar-focused Tours have been added to Career mode in the form of the Champions Cup, the new home of competition for single-player racing.[/p][p]Dive into the world of Motorsport in a variety of modern and historical racecars. Immerse yourself in multiple disciplines of events inspired by real world racing from one-make series to endurance spectacles. Prove your skills on the track to unlock Invitationals and complete them to earn some of the most highly coveted reward cars that have been added to the game since its release.[/p][p]Here’s a closer look at the Tours and Invitationals featured in the Champions Cup:[/p][h3][b]One-Make Tour[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/273ca45eb6ce170665f5f672c00ed4dd25142ffc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Start your journey in the Champions Cup with the One-Make Tour. Experience progressively faster and more expensive one-make series in events focused on driver skill and spec car mastery. These include Ginetta Juniors, MX-5 Cup, KTM X-Bow GT4, 488 Challenge and Lamborghini Challenge.[/p][p]Complete all five series in the One-Make Tour to get the 1979 BMW #6 BMW Motorsport M1 Procar. You’ll also receive an invitation to participate in the Early BMW Challenge Series where you can obtain the epic 2023 BMW #96 Turner Motorsport M4 GT3.[/p][h3][b]Touring World Tour[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/1f84eb66f574616f39e1ac25d17c95114cd39761.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Experience Touring Car racing with the second Tour of the Champions Cup. Challenge yourself across three regional series, each consisting of 8 races in American Touring Car, Eastern Touring Car, and European Touring Car.[/p][p]Showcase your skills across this trio of series and you will receive the 1989 Audi #4 Audi 90 quattro IMSA GTO added to your garage.[/p][p]You’ll also be invited to the Retro GT Invitational Series where you can unlock another reward car: the iconic 1998 Nissan #23 Pennzoil NISMO Skyline GT-R.[/p][h3][b]Thunder Tour[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/803996a24ed5087258bf977ca05b8799e77d6b00.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The V8 has always been synonymous with Motorsport – and power and speed are at the heart of the Thunder Tour.[/p][p]Master four unique disciplines of competition that epitomize the V8 racing experience: Australian Supercars, Forza T/A, Modern NASCAR, and IndyCar.[/p][p]In the Forza T/A Series, we’ve also included the 2014 Dodge #93 SRT Motorsports Viper GTS-R alongside the four Forza T/A cars in the Forza Motorsport Car Pass. This is to ensure all players, even those who don’t own any of the DLC cars, can complete these events.[/p][p]Prove your abilities on the track and you will be challenged to participate in the Historic Endurance Invitational Series. Race in the 1966 Ford #2 GT40 MkII Le Mans reward car to obtain another car to add to your collection, the classic 1988 Chevrolet #77 Beretta Trans Am.[/p][h3][b]Single Seat Tour[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/b025ca8aab523126f7a2c877b9d6e8fb2472d873.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Open wheel racing is a storied legacy of motorsports. Experience it in the Single Seat Tour of the Champions Cup.[/p][p]Single seater cars are a true test of competitive aptitude where every step on the ladder takes drivers to the ultimate culmination of open-wheel mastery.[/p][p]Complete Grand Prix Rivals, Formula 60s, and Formula 70s, and get the 1939 Auto Union Type D, alongside an invite to the Birth of Grand Prix Invitational Series where you can win the open-wheel 1977 Renault #15 Equipe Renault Elf R.S. 01.[/p][h3][b]Endurance Tour[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/1a29b419da02ed1d93d9ba31d9b443d16f970d72.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Endurance Tour is the absolute pinnacle of the Champions Cup.[/p][p]Strap in for longer races with ultra-competitive GT racecars and cutting-edge prototype hypercars.[/p][p]Test your racing skills, as well as your tire and fuel strategy across American GT3, Global GTE, Daytona Prototype, European LMP2, Global Endurance, and American LMDh.[/p][p]Complete all six series to join the final stage of Champions Cup, the GPT Endurance Invitational Series, where you can race in the legendary 1991 Mazda #55 Mazda 787B and compete to unlock another reward car of the same stature: the 1988 Nissan #24 International R88C.[/p][h3][b]Invitationals[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/86fe6cbc4332365248ce0c0cdd5ae18a89e6c166.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Completion of each Tour in the Champions Cup unlocks an Invitational. These one-off series highlight brilliant moments in motorsport and feature their own reward cars.[/p][p]Here’s a summary of all the reward cars you can get by playing the Champions Cup:[/p][list][*][p][b]One Make Tour[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Tour Reward Car:[/b] 1979 BMW #6 BMW Motorsport M1 Procar[/p][/*][*][p][b]Invitational Series:[/b] Early BMW Challenge[/p][/*][*][p][b]Invitational Reward Car:[/b] 2023 BMW #96 Turner Motorsport M4 GT3[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Touring World Tour[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Tour Reward Car:[/b] 1989 Audi #4 Audi are obtained regardless of your final position in each event, so feel free to crank up the difficulty and [b][u][url="https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-drivatar-changes"]experience the improvements that our multi-line Drivatar AI system brings to single-player racing.[/url][/u][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/778d5f71dd4a4ecb89dd0ab6e3f8d3d22571c6c4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Champions Cup is a free extension to the Career mode, and all five of its Tours as well as their unlockable Invitational events will always be available for you to play, so you can complete them at your own pace.[/p][p]To make the Champions Cup more accessible to all players, we have adjusted the in-game pricing for most racecars. Of the cars affected, 162 (87%) of them saw a decrease in their price. This means most racecars will now be more affordable to purchase from the Showroom. [b][u][url="https://aka.ms/FMUpdate21RN"]A full breakdown of all car pricing adjustments can be seen in the release notes.[/url][/u][/b][/p][h2][b]Replay Your Favorite Featured Tours[/b][/h2][p]Previous Featured Tours and reward cars make their return in Update 21, starting on July 3 with the Road to Race Tour, with an additional Tour coming back to the game every month. This includes the Track Toys Tour on August 7, followed by the Ringer Tour on September 4, and so on.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/7d4e2f1326c82028234aea6d1088836fb02bff63.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Featured Tours will be unlocked in their entirety, which means all series within a Tour will be available as soon as it is active. Upon their return, each Tour and any associated rewards will be permanently available for all players to enjoy.[/p][p]Whether you’re replaying your favorite Featured Tour or are playing it for the very first time, all returning Tours will appear within the Featured tab in Career.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/3a2f26171877a27f8cc2deea854e6070586c99a4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Additionally, all previous Open Class Tour reward cars will be earnable by completing challenges in the Challenge Hub. These new challenges will be introduced on the same monthly cadence as the returning Featured Tours and will be permanently available in the Featured tab within Challenge Hub.[/p][h2][b]Build Your Cars in the Expanded Open Tour[/b][/h2][p]With Update 21, the Open Class Tour has been expanded to feature every class in the game! This means you can enjoy racing the slower cars in E Class and D Class all the way to the fastest and most competitive cars in P Class and X Class![/p][p]Enjoy the flexibility to tune and upgrade the cars you love to race with minimal restrictions.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/5c1d2cceec6c3d330c6e237e264bfbf83a86b238.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Complete every series of the Open Class Tour and you will receive the 2024 Nissan Z NISMO.[/p][p]This version of the Open Class Tour will always be available to enter! Check it out in Career mode and ensure you have all your favorite cars upgraded so you can bring them into each series.[/p][h2][b]Smash Lap Time Records in Open Division Rivals[/b][/h2][p]Feeling confident in your car building capabilities? Jump into Open Division Rivals, a new category of Rivals events that challenges builders to create the top-performing car within each production car division within a set PI limit.[/p][p]This is also a great place to practice and test your build for the return of the Cycled Production Series in Featured Multiplayer – [b][u][url="https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-21#multiplayer"]see This Meetup takes drivers all around the globe onto tracks that allow even the fastest cars to be pushed to their absolute limit.[/p][h3][b]Cycled Ovals Track Day Meetup[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/e3f60d4cfc12e9a8c9dd175a40a7dba27a53ca3d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This Meetup is perfect for motorsport enthusiasts looking to experience the unique challenges, culture, and excitement of oval racing.[/p][h2][b]Play Your Favorite Featured Multiplayer Series[/b][/h2][p]In Update 21, Featured Multiplayer has been reorganized, incorporating player feedback, with the goal of providing players with even more event variety.[/p][p]Due to the changes outlined below, some of the Series that were scheduled to be active between June 12 through June 19 may no longer be available after downloading the update, however some of these events, such as Week 7 of the 20th Anniversary Series will re-appear on June 19 at the normal weekly schedule change. Read on for further information.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/d48c8201a163b6584735c57f3183021f45fea238.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Here's an outline of the changes made for each category of events in Featured Multiplayer, as well as an overview of the series rotation schedule and race lengths to expect within each series.[/p][p][b]Featured[/b][/p][p]The ‘Featured’ category has been updated to focus on some of our most popular racing series, putting them front and center for all players to easily jump into, including the new IndyCar Series![/p][p][b]Spec Events[/b][/p][p]The ‘Spec Events’ category will now include a number of series, cycling between a rotation of one-make staples (such as MX-5 Cup, Ginetta Juniors, Formula Mazda, etc.) as well as historical spec division series.[/p][p][b]Semi-Open Events[/b][/p][p]A new ‘Semi-Open Events’ category has been added and focuses on events that challenge drivers to build and race their very own project car within a loose set of cycled car restrictions and themes.[/p][p]This includes a series that some players may recognize from previous Forza Motorsport titles – the Cycled Production Series! This series will feature a new Production Division each day, each with its own Max PI restriction.[/p][p]Additionally, this category will feature a rotating assortment of multi-class series, as well as other unique car building-focused events, such as the Mid-Engine Series, a new AWD series, 6 Cylinder Series, and more![/p][p][b]Open Events[/b][/p][p]Finally, one of our top community requests – all Open Class Series have been made permanently available in the ‘Open Events’ category. notes.title: Get Your 20th Anniversary Rewards in the Challenge Hub
notes.content:
Forza Motorsport’s 20th Anniversary Update introduces new rewards in the Challenge Hub. Prove your skills in previous Forza Motorsport cover cars across refreshed Featured Challenges and Weekly Challenges. 

Challenge Hub objectives are spread across Career, Featured Multiplayer and Rivals. By playing these game modes, you can earn credit rewards, cars and race suits, including the special Forza Motorsport suits themed around each previously released game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/ee7b8e24459e744a2c12c1d10ee3868dfaf0ef9c.jpg[/img]
Car rewards in the Challenge Hub for 20th Anniversary include the new-to-Motorsport [b]2022 Acura NSX Type S[/b] and [b]2024 Nissan Z NISMO[/b], both unlockable by completing the Spirit of Motorsport Tour and Open Class Tour, respectively. 

In addition, the [b]1984 Toyota #25 Horsepower Techs Starlet Time Attack[/b] and [b]1995 Formula Drift #34 Toyota Supra MkIV[/b] are also obtainable in their respective Rivals events. 

There are also new Forza Motorsport Rival Celebration events where you can earn anniversary themed liveries for the cover cars. As noted above, some of these rewards will be sent out to players after the events have wrapped up.

[h2]Speed Up in 20th Anniversary Rivals [/h2]

New Featured Rivals events are also available for the 20th Anniversary celebrations. 

In Fujimi Kaido Touge, go head-to-head with your rivals to celebrate the return of a classic track! Set your fastest lap around Fujimi Kaido in the [b]1984 Toyota #25 Horsepower Techs Starlet Time Attack[/b]. Complete a clean lap in this event to add this new-to-Motorsport car to your collection for free! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/c0fd5479d32f33d0d23b867ca7a22660b50e4045.jpg[/img]
Go sideways on Fujimi Kaido – Full Circuit Reverse in the Ghost of Fujimi Drift Rivals. Enjoy the upgraded series-spec version of the [b]1985 Toyota Sprinter Trueno GT Apex[/b] and take in the scenery while sliding through Fujimi Kaido’s memorable curves. 

Meanwhile, in Super Supra, get your tires spinning around Grand Oak in the [b]1995 Formula Drift #34 Toyota Supra MkIV[/b] and earn as many drift points as you can! Get a Drift Score of 20,000 or higher in this Drift Rivals event to receive this new-to-Motorsport car in your garage at no cost. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/3a958f7f878536b92f0ebb91126f93c5cce056d0.jpg[/img]
Remember the very first time you played the latest Forza Motorsport? Take a trip down memory lane driving your favorite Cadillac Racing V-Series.R around the Hakone - Grand Prix Circuit in the Cadillac Throwback VIP Rivals. 

In addition to Spotlight Rivals highlighting each of the previous Forza Motorsport cover cars, we will also be running special Anniversary Rivals over the next few months that gives you another chance to compete in events using these iconic cars. These bi-weekly events will also be your opportunity to obtain exclusive anniversary liveries. Some of these will be immediately available to apply to the respective car, while others will be made available after their associated Rivals event concludes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/131eab92329824609fcca7accef7858565cd80c1.jpg[/img]
The Logitech McLaren G Challenge returns for summer! Race for $50,000+ in cash, prizes, and the opportunity to visit the McLaren Technology Centre in England! Sign up at [url=https://Discord.gg/LogitechG]Discord.gg/LogitechG[/url] to confirm eligibility and qualify for prizes from Logitech G. Top drivers per region qualify for the Grand Finals on August 23-24. Get behind the wheel of the [b]1988 McLaren #12 Honda McLaren MP4/4[/b] at Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps in the first qualifier, and at Hakone – GP Circuit in the second.

notes.title: Ignite Your Passion in the Spirit of Motorsport Tour
notes.content:
This new Featured Tour will allow players to take a trip down memory lane and re-discover each of the previous Forza Motorsport titles in a special homage that celebrates a small part of what made each of these games so special to so many in our Forza community. We also brought back an old friend to narrate the introduction to the 20th Anniversary Tour... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/1ad45b187b707b8062aa89b2649f812b2a8c55bf.jpg[/img]
That’s not all! [b]A selection of iconic music from Forza Motorsport 3, 4, 5 and 6 has been added to the game’s soundtrack playlist.[/b] We also commissioned 3 entirely new sequences of music from Forza Motorsport 3-5 composer, Lance Hayes, which have also been added to the music playlist. You will hear these pieces before and after races, in the main menu, and when loading into events. 

Over the next seven weeks, a new [b]Showcase Series[/b] in the Spirit of Motorsport Tour will become available to play, highlighting a previously released Forza Motorsport game and its cover car. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/22b458fd527e20d5d6531a75bf49bc3f2282c9c5.jpg[/img]
Starting with the [b]Spirit of Forza Motorsport (2005)[/b], here’s a closer look at each of the Spirit of Motorsport series you can look forward to playing in this commemorative Featured Tour: 

[h2]Spirit of Forza Motorsport[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/2c0b39260bbf1c16c5fd9a0bb6a6b66800f140b0.jpg[/img]
[i]Where Dreams Are Driven[/i] 

Relive the moment that started it all. Race the [b]2005 Honda NSX-R[/b] featuring a celebratory Forza Motorsport livery and MUGEN body kit on Fujimi Kaido and other iconic Forza tracks.  

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Spirit of Forza Motorsport 2[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/f6d8c9e2e45e0f55fe6a84cb0cb42ca62ea2222a.jpg[/img]
[i]Making Moves on the Track [/i]

New mainstay racing modes made their debut in Forza Motorsport 2 as the series cemented its place in the racing genre. You’re invited to race in that game's beloved cover car, the [b]2003 Nissan Fairlady Z[/b], and experience what made it so special. 

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Spirit of Forza Motorsport 3[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/1006ad3531c2de15c3b620946259063a9752059a.jpg[/img]
[i]Your Invitation to Speed [/i]

With car upgrades, tuning and painting, customization features were at the heart of Forza Motorsport 3 alongside its astonishing cover car that marked the start of a new decade: the [b]2010 Audi R8 5.2 FSI quattro[/b]. 

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Spirit of Forza Motorsport 4[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/74033afd0ddf071af529a2015e9f8483f0e98695.jpg[/img]
[i]An Endangered Species[/i] 

Celebrated as a favorite amongst many Forza enthusiasts in our community, Forza Motorsport 4 introduced new social and online features to connect our players. Its beautiful cover car, the [b]2009 Ferrari 458 Italia[/b], is adored globally by petrolheads. 

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Spirit of Forza Motorsport 5 [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/1f63ab01f1ce888a06c54fd2769f60e96cf18af5.jpg[/img]
[i]A New Generation of Racing [/i]

Marking the start of a new console, Forza Motorsport 5 charged out onto the racetrack with stunning visuals, enhanced physics, and open-wheel racecars. Race the [b]2013 McLaren P1[/b] and discover the technical, ultra-innovative capabilities of the Holy Hybrid Trinity. 

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Spirit of Forza Motorsport 6 [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/c0a057bca6c1cb583e6e38c426e0701688398d11.jpg[/img]
[i]What We’ve Been Racing Towards [/i]

Forza Motorsport 6 marked the return of a legend – the [b]2017 Ford GT[/b]. It also featured rain and night racing, 24-player races, new ways to race competitively, and a single-player that celebrated the history of automobiles and racing: Stories of Motorsport. 

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Spirit of Forza Motorsport 7 [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/961e526000b8eb9d99423ac7dbb39fe8106b1fb5.jpg[/img]
[i]The Danger and Beauty of Racing [/i]

Pitched as the ultimate automotive playset, Forza Motorsport 7 introduced 4K HDR racing with a huge variety of cars to collect, dynamic weather scenarios, and racing suits. It even unveiled a brand-new car on the world stage: the [b]2018 Porsche 911 GT2 RS[/b]. 

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Spirit of Motorsport Tour Reward [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/06c00c7cc2e77619d9c579ddc7893cf4625ddc04.jpg[/img]
Complete all seven series in the Spirit of Motorsport Tour in Career to get the [b]2022 Acura NSX Type S[/b] from the Challenge Hub. This new-to-Motorsport car is also obtainable by completing 20 races in the 20th Anniversary Series in Featured Multiplayer. 

[h2]Race Your Favorite Cars in the Open Tour [/h2]

Once you have experienced the legacy of Forza Motorsport in the Spirit of Motorsport Tour, check out the Open Class Tour to continue the journey of your favorite cars. Available under the Featured tab in Career mode. 

Open Class Tour is where you can experiment with different upgrades and showcase your favorite tuned cars. Each update to Forza Motorsport refreshes the Open Class Tour with new events and a different reward car. Cars you’ve already upgraded in a different Builders Cup series can be further levelled up in the Open Class Tour. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/5c1d2cceec6c3d330c6e237e264bfbf83a86b238.jpg[/img]
The Open Class Tour features six series, each with three races, that range from D Class to R Class. Upgrade your cars through each event and use them to complete all six series in the Open Class Tour before June 18, 2025, and you will receive the [b]2024 Nissan Z NISMO[/b]. 

You can also unlock this new-to-Motorsport car by completing 10 races in any Open Series in Featured Multiplayer.

notes.title: Meetup at Fujimi Kaido for Forza Motorsport’s 20th Anniversary
notes.content:
[b]Forza Motorsport Update 20[/b] is a celebration of our 20-year history, and there is no better way to mark this milestone than with the return of a fan favorite track that has a legendary status amongst our community: [b]Fujimi Kaido[/b]. 

To help you make the most out of Fujimi Kaido with your friends, this update also introduces one of the top-requested features for Motorsport: Public Meetups. These new multiplayer events will feature Open Track Day and Drift Meetups, where you can vote for the next track to play on, a 24/7 Fujimi Kaido Drift Meetup, and Nürburgring Nordschleife Track Day Meetup. 

[previewyoutube=7Bzcl1uVXQo;full][/previewyoutube]

You’ll be able to take the wheel behind each of the cover cars from previous Forza Motorsport games– each with newly updated audio – in the Spirit of Motorsport Tour, the 20th Anniversary Multiplayer Series, and Spotlight Rivals. In addition, we’ll have driver suits themed for each previously released Forza Motorsport game as well as the new-to-Motorsport [b]2022 Acura NSX Type S[/b] and [b]2024 Nissan Z NISMO[/b] in the Challenge Hub. 

Meanwhile, the new-to-Motorsport [b]1984 Toyota #25 Horsepower Techs Starlet Time Attack[/b] and [b]1995 Formula Drift #34 Toyota Supra MkIV[/b] can be earned and added to your garage for free from their respective Featured Rivals and Drift Rivals events. Both cars alongside the [b]2005 #1 Sierra Enterprises Lancer Evolution Time Attack[/b] are also available in the Showroom. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/2d1c089e3af42f9e6255c7c7501a4de745563553.jpg[/img]
There’s even a new Car Pack! Unleash your adrenaline in the fan favorite [b]2008 Mazda Furai[/b] and 4 exhilarating new-to-Motorsport cars – the [b]2024 Ford Mustang GT3, 2001 Formula Drift #215 Nissan Silvia Spec-R, 1997 Toyota Mark II Tourer V JZX100[/b], and [b]1984 De Tomaso Pantera GT5[/b]. Get the Forza Motorsport: Racing Heroes Car Pack for [i]$4.99|€4.99|£3.99[/i] at the Microsoft Store or Steam. 

We also have a special gift to help you get started in the Spirit of Motorsport Tour. As the cover car of the original Forza Motorsport game released 20 years ago, the [b]2005 Honda NSX-R[/b] has a new [i]MUGEN[/i] body kit ready to be fitted, as well as a special 20th Anniversary livery that is being sent to all players. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/57971b5639c0dfe2bf75405c3a99dc9425ee5bb6.jpg[/img]
In addition to all the anniversary content, Forza Motorsport Update 20 introduces improvements to AI and racing wheel features. With a new [b]multi-line AI system[/b], you’ll experience cleaner and safer racing from Drivatars. For players who use wheels, we’re introducing [b]steering wheel calibration[/b] and lock-to-lock turns designed to be specific and authentic to each car in the game. 

Thank you for playing our games. Your passion and dedication to both cars and Forza has fueled the community over these past 20 years. Have fun driving sideways with your friends at Fujimi Kaido, enjoy a nostalgic trip through automotive history in the Spirit of Motorsport Tour, and participate in Public Meetups to show off your favorite cars and skills to the world! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/0475c2eb9d05f2425fde3190b1ac98fb42bd431f.jpg[/img]
Update 20 also introduces one of the top-requested features for Motorsport: Public Meetups. In addition, there are [b]improvements to AI and racing wheel features[/b]. 

There’s a lot to cover in Update 20, so let's take a closer look at each of these new additions below, as well as a preview of our release notes. 

[h2]Fujimi Kaido: A Legend Reborn! [/h2]

You’ve asked for it, and it’s finally returned... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/b974979bbeb2299e7b52ce5bff6c453bbeeef509.jpg[/img]
Welcome to Fujimi Kaido, a legendary destination for drift enthusiasts and motorsport lovers alike! 

At 16.5 kilometers or 10.24 miles, with an elevation of 826 meters, or 2,711 feet, this iconic stretch of winding mountain roads is a true paradise for those seeking the thrill of precision driving. With its sharp hairpin turns, steep inclines, and breathtaking descents, Fujimi Kaido challenges drivers to master the art of controlled slides as they navigate its serpentine path. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/9e7a53f5f2b560d7bdfa7f92ad3dc2046319c0c2.jpg[/img]
Whether you're a seasoned drifter or a newcomer eager to test your skills, this drifting and touge racing mecca offers an unforgettable experience, blending adrenaline-pumping action with stunning scenic views of the surrounding landscape. 

Experience Fujimi Kaido across all modes including Career, Featured Multiplayer, Rivals, and Free Play, as well as our newest addition, Public Meetups. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/0c7bde764b5d7c1e471ddd47ca3779dd6a579dc9.jpg[/img]
Fujimi Kaido is both a love letter to Japan and a tribute to our fans. We hope you have fun racing and drifting with your friends on all 144 of its extreme turns.  

[url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-fujimi-kaido]Discover even more about the history of the track and explore the details of its latest incarnation in our behind-the-scenes Fujimi Kaido blog! [/url]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Make New Friends in Public Meetups[/h2] 

Public Meetups are here! Meetups invite you and your friends to join other players on-track without the pressure of competition, car restrictions or race rules. Jump into Open Track Day Meetups where you can put down your best lap time or flaunt your drifting skills in Drift Meetups! 

In Meetups you can drive, tune, upgrade your car, or just find a nice parking spot and enjoy the dynamic time of day and weather on any one of your favorite tracks. With Track Voting you can vote to change the track at any time for the current Meetup event!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/b5dd499277e4be60d79caeceee86694f34d47ec5.jpg[/img]
In Update 20, we will have four Meetups available to select from at any time:  

[list]
[*] [b]Fujimi Kaido Drift Meetup[/b] – Go sideways on massive stretches of serpentine Japanese mountain roads in this 24/7 Meetup at Fujimi Kaido with Drift Scoring enabled. 
[*] [b]Cycled Track Drift Meetup[/b] – All 73 track layouts are available in this Drift Meetup where you can vote for your favorite drift track. 
[*] [b]Nürburgring Nordschleife Track Day Meetup[/b] – Tackle the ‘Green Hell’ in this 24/7 Meetup at the Nordschleife – the perfect track to test any car build and put it through its paces. 
[*] [b]Cycled Track Day Meetup[/b] - All 73 track layouts are available in this Meetup where you’re encouraged to set your best lap time on any track, in any car. 
[/list]

Select the Race option from the main menu to join any of the above four Public Meetups. To switch cars while in a Meetup, you need to go back to the pre-race menu. Pause the game and select ‘Exit -> Leave Race’ to return to the Pre-Race menu. 

[hr][/hr]
[h2]New Steering Wheel Features in Update 20[/h2] 

This update adds new wheel features to Forza Motorsport, including steering wheel calibration and authentic car specific turns lock-to-lock. This will be most noticeable for race cars, which typically have fewer degrees of steering lock-to-lock.   

Prior to this release, the default steering behavior was to use the full range of your steering wheel for all cars – which could be tuned globally in the Settings menu or per-car through the Tuning Setup menu.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/146d51333eaa910092709ffe9ea220f8e52f1cec.jpg[/img]
With this release, now that we are accurately simulating steering sensitivity for each car, we needed to reset the user's "Steering Lock Range" in the Tune Setup menu as well as the "Steering Sensitivity" in the Settings menu.  

The default force feedback settings have been adjusted for most wheels as well. If you have already tuned your steering wheel settings, the new default settings will not overwrite your configuration.  Check out the Advanced Wheel settings to calibrate your wheel for the best experience. 

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Multi-Line AI System[/h2] 

With Forza Motorsport Update 20, we’ve introduced a major update to our Drivatar AI system with significant improvements to collision avoidance and side-by-side behavior, especially during those tricky race starts.  

[url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-drivatar-changes]Check out this blog for a more detailed overview about this AI update. [/url]

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Changes to Drivatar AI Coming in Forza Motorsport Update 20
notes.content:
Let’s talk about the [b]Drivatar AI[/b] in Forza Motorsport, and how we’ve been working on important changes for our community to improve the experience of driving against the AI in traffic. We’re excited to share a preview of those updates today, which you can look forward to trying in the game when Update 20 is released this May. 

Before we jump into the changes, we want to reflect on the AI system we created for Forza Motorsport in 2023, and how it has evolved since the release of the game. 

Since launch, we’ve made improvements to passing behavior, reduced instances of unnecessary braking, and prevented cars from following the racing lines too strictly. We also added support for new tracks and events, such as the oval circuits that are featured in NASCAR. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/74158e20fcd63b52bc21712b2b73399c629ef756.jpg[/img]
With Forza Motorsport, our goal was to make the AI more competitive with our fastest players. We run the simulation through thousands of laps on a per track layout, per car type basis. This builds a custom racing line, enabling the AI to drive really fast on any given track. To dial in the AI system, we also gathered feedback from the community, including sim-racers and professional racing drivers, to help us achieve the desired pace and proficiency. This process even included input from some of our own designers here at Turn 10, who compete in autocross and racing events in their free time. 

When driving in traffic, the system frequently moves to a dynamic racing line as the Drivatars try to find their own ideal line on the track. This can result in sub-optimal driving performance, such as collisions, AI driving off track, or things that a professional driver would not do. Here is what we would like to see in our Drivatar AI to ensure you can enjoy fun and engaging single-player racing: 

[list]
[*] Faster, even when they are not on the optimal racing line. 
[*] Skilled and defensive, providing exciting competition. 
[*] Capable of overtaking the player and passing other AI opponents without veering off track. 
[*] Able to better limit collisions and off-track behaviors, including awkward mergers when they attempt to return to the ideal racing line.
[/list] 

To get us closer to the outcomes listed above, we've developed and will be releasing a multi-line AI system that is trained on multiple lines of traffic, giving Drivatars more options for the optimized racing lines they can follow. This update should improve side-by-side racing in heavy traffic scenarios, allowing AI to skillfully and consistently race without erratic driving behavior when it's not forced to stay on the optimal line.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/8f55aecf4abb59d408b868aa4ac12315d16837dc.jpg[/img]
Another great aspect of our new [b]multi-line system[/b] is that the AI can now elegantly blend between different racing lines in traffic. Like before, they can still drive fast by themselves, however with this update they also benefit from race start behavior improvements, collision avoidance, situational awareness, and improved passing behavior. All while being able to drive fast and safe when around other opponents on the track. 

The new multi-line system is the new foundation for Drivatar AI training in Forza Motorsport. As we look ahead, it sets us up for more authentic opponents in our games – building offensive and defensive behaviors that will lead to more competitive and engaging racing. 

We can’t wait for you to compete against the new Drivatar AI that is being released with Forza Motorsport Update 20 next month. As always, we will be keen to hear your thoughts about it and how you would like to see it further evolve in the future. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/05a444dbec2a63b1b2c6c61c6053910a632c2f6e.jpg[/img]
For more details on our [b]20th Anniversary celebration[/b] in our Forza Motorsport, including the return of the fan favorite [b]Fujimi Kaido[/b] track, [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-20-anniversary]check out this blog[/url]. Remember to follow our social channels on [url=https://www.facebook.com/forzamotorsport/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/forzamotorsport/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@Forza]YouTube[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/forza]Discord[/url], and [url=https://twitter.com/ForzaMotorsport]X (formerly Twitter)[/url] where you can stay up to date with our community and the latest, ongoing in-game events. In addition, be sure to [url=https://forza.net/newsletter]sign up for the Forza Newsletter[/url] and receive all the latest Forza news delivered straight to your inbox.

notes.title: Master Porsche Racing Icons in Forza Motorsport
notes.content:
The distinctive style of Porsche sports cars is among the most recognizable silhouettes in the automotive world, with exceptional performance to match. Celebrate the legacy of Porsche and their racing icons in Forza Motorsport Update 19. 

New-to-Motorsport Porsche cars are entering the Showroom as Spotlight cars, while others are available as reward cars in the Challenge Hub. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/cf4db6206b7941e73e68791a6c536b4129a14701.png[/img]

Complete the Porsche Tour to earn the new-to-Motorsport 1981 Porsche #1 Porsche System Engineering 924 GTP Le Mans, and the Open Class Tour to get the new-to-Motorsport 2023 Porsche 911 Turbo S. Over in the Showroom, acquire the 1978 Porsche #43 Porsche Racing 935/78 and 2023 Porsche 911 GT3 R – the latter of which is also obtainable for free from the Challenge Hub. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/966653f969141edea05cf6d58ba3d47b260b784a.png[/img]

Spotlight cars over the next four weeks include the 1971 Porsche #23 917/20, 1987 Porsche #203 Porsche AG 961, 2016 Porsche Cayman GT4, and 1978 Porsche #78 MOMO 935/78. 

In addition, you can also gear up for the racing events ahead and ensure you look the part on the track with the new unlockable Earth Day and Rewind Driver Suits in the Challenge Hub.  

Meanwhile, whether you prefer GT racecars, prototype hypercars, touring cars or classic open-wheel racers, new permanent Spec Division Rivals await your fastest leaderboard lap times! 

[h2]Game Improvements and Release Notes 
[/h2]
Forza Motorsport Update 19 rolls out for download starting Monday, April 7 on Xbox Series X|S and PC via the Microsoft Store and Steam. Spotlight cars and new in-game events will begin on Wednesday, April 9 starting at 5:00 PM PT (12:00 AM UTC on Thursday, April 10). 

Below is an overview of the changes and improvements included with Update 19: 
[list]
[*] Car audio for the 2016 Ford Shelby GT-350R, 2015 Jaguar F-Type R Coupé, and 2011 Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG has been updated based on community feedback.
[*] Updated default track rubbering-in behavior in both Career and Featured Multiplayer:
[list] 
[*] Practice will now always start at 20% rubbered in (previously 33%) 
[*] Races will now always start at 75% rubbered in (previously 66%)[/list] 
[*] Removed the following cars from the Featured Multiplayer Forza GT3 Series eligible car list with plans for a future release of dedicated one-make series of each car, to more accurately reflect their usage in real-world motorsport: [list]
[*] 2018 Lamborghini #63 Squadra Corse Huracán Super Trofeo Evo 
[*] 2015 Lamborghini #63 Squadra Corse Huracán LP620-2 Super Trofeo 
[*] 2017 Ferrari #25 Corse Clienti 488 Challenge[/list] 
[*] Like our rebalancing overhaul of Forza Touring Cars in Update 17, we’re introducing a new Spec/BoP overhaul for both the Forza GT2 and Forza GT3 Series in Update 19. As with the Forza Touring Car overhaul, all Forza GT2 and Forza GT3 cars have been reverted to stock parts – except for tire width to normalize – and re-tuned with feedback from participants in our [url=https://forza.net/insiders]Forza Insiders Program.[/url]
[/list] 
[url=https://aka.ms/FMUpdate19RN]For a full list of fixes, improvements and other changes in Forza Motorsport Update 19 – including a detailed overview of the tuning changes made to each car in the Forza GT2 and Forza GT3 Series – check out the release notes. [/url]

[h2]Experience Porsche in the Featured Tour   [/h2]

The Porsche Tour invites you on a journey to discover how the German manufacturer’s commitment to innovation and excellence has led to an impressive trophy cabinet of motorsport victories that span multiple decades.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/29b9efb2534c9ab8f7bccbfd917d605d5c7ee9ac.png[/img]

Get behind the wheel of the latest Porsches in the Showroom and compete in both Porsche production cars and racecars in Porsche Motorsport Icons, Porsche Endurance, Mid-Engine Porsche, and Rear-Engine Porsche.   

[h2]Porsche Motorsport Icons [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/26e22ee60473714a3e67aebd719d1e687d8b689e.png[/img]

The early 1970s proved to be an exciting time for Porsche. Its cars filled out the racing divisions of competitions across the world. In 1971, the 1971 Porsche #23 917/20, with its rose-colored livery and unique looks, helped establish itself as an icon in the motorsport world. Infamously referred to as the “Pink Pig,” the 917/20, while never crossing the checkered flag, certainly cemented its place in the history books. It lives in its unique livery at Porsche’s Stuttgart-Zuffenhausen museum, but now you can experience the 917’s both icon establishing and ill-fated run at “the big race” in your attempt to finish what it originally set out to do. 

[h2]Porsche Endurance [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/08c4796425e2f0d4ef43aaf42dcdf29c6fb7067c.png[/img]

In the late 1980s, Porsche continued its legacy in endurance racing with the 1987 Porsche #203 Porsche AG 961. Unfortunately, during the 1987 big race, driver Kees Nierop got into an accident in the eighteenth hour which set the car on fire. It never had the opportunity to race again, due to both the fire and lack of similar class competitors following the event. Experience an alternate history for the 961 as it races against other race cars of the era. 
[h2]
Mid-Engine Porsche [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/9f354c729ff9b72d494e122b4378eac70e11560f.png[/img]

Although the 2016 Porsche Cayman GT4 runs on a 911 Engine, it’s a third-generation mid-engine Porsche that gave an alternative to the base 911 of that era. With its front suspension lifted directly from a Porsche GT3 along with its higher tuned horsepower, it provides a hefty base for the Cayman platform. Not many of these were made, so hop into this car and give it a spin against competitors of the mid-2010s. 

[h2]Rear-Engine Porsche [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/a0952665d5473b6912981f0fa523a0536e36c3bc.png[/img]

Considered the ultimate expression for the 911 factory racecar of the 1970s, the 1978 Porsche #78 MOMO 935/78 is a unique car in Porsche Motorsport history and was well known for its new at the time rear end design. Housing not only an engine, but radiators that cooled the cylinder heads mounted ahead of the rear wheels, and an adjustable wing that was set above the engine. While it raced only a few times on the track, the 935/78 made its mark in the 1978 Silverstone six-hour race where it outperformed its competitors by a wide margin to secure its drivers a first-place result. 
[h2]
Porsche Tour Reward [/h2]

Complete all four series in the Porsche Tour in Career before May 21, 2025, to unlock the new-to-Motorsport 1981 Porsche #1 Porsche System Engineering 924 GTP Le Mans from the Challenge Hub. This car is also obtainable by completing 10 races in the Porsche Motorsport Series in Featured Multiplayer.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/be0b5430a95ed97c8dc00370fbf31871b85939df.png[/img]

In the 1980s, the reliability of the 924 GTP made it a popular contender at The Big Race, so it's only fitting that the Reward Showcase for the Porsche Tour will see you reliving those battles at the Old Mulsanne Circuit. 
[h2]
Upgrade Your Porsches in the Open Tour  
[/h2]
Once you have experienced the legacy of Porsche Motorsport, check out the Open Class Tour to continue the journey of your favorite Porsches. Available under the Featured tab in Career mode.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/f90494328e5f8635cd28b69de0990ac185bb7291.png[/img]

Open Class Tour is where you can experiment with different upgrades and showcase your favorite tuned cars. Each update to Forza Motorsport refreshes the Open Class Tour with new events and a different reward car. Cars you’ve already upgraded in a different Builders Cup series can be further levelled up in the Open Class Tour.  

The Open Class Tour features six series, each with three races, that range from D Class to R Class. Upgrade your cars through each event and use them to complete all six series in the Open Class Tour before May 7, 2025, and you will receive the 2023 Porsche 911 Turbo S.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/bb55877e0720fb42d4b76c92f1f02f839a049efd.png[/img]

You can also unlock this new-to-Motorsport car by completing 10 races in any Open Series in Featured Multiplayer. 

[h2]Spotlight Cars and VIP Discounts [/h2]

Spotlight cars are featured in the Showroom every week. These cars correspond to the available in-game events and can be acquired with a temporary 30% discount using in-game credits. 

Porsche Month introduces four Spotlight cars to the Showroom, one per week. These Spotlight cars can be used in the Porsche Tour and Spotlight Rivals, the Porsche Motorsport Series in Featured Multiplayer, as well as to complete Challenge Hub objectives.

[h2]Set Your Fastest Laps in Spec Division Rivals [/h2]

With Forza Motorsport Update 19, we are also introducing Spec Division Rivals. Compete for the top of the leaderboard in your favorite car from select divisions while utilizing the same Spec Series (BoP) tune from Featured Multiplayer in this new permanent category of Rivals events! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/33aa9c2079b7bf7738a0c22e7fde357a38eeab35.png[/img]

Spec Division Rivals events will be a great place to set lap times in a wide variety of competitively balanced cars, as well as practice for Featured Multiplayer events, and find tunes – even if that particular series isn’t currently active – on a track that is well-suited for each division of cars.    

Pick your favorite car in each class and set your fastest lap times across the following groups: 

Early Factory Racecar | Early LMP | Formula 60s | Formula 70s | Formula Mazda | Forza AUS | Forza GT2 | Forza GT3 | Forza GT4 | Forza P1 | Forza P2 | Forza Proto-H | Forza Touring Cars | Grand Prix Rivals | GTP/C | GTX Sportscars | Modern Factory Racecars | NASCAR | Prototype Group Racing | The Birth of Grand Prix | Vintage Le Mans Prototypes | Vintage Le Mans Sportscars

notes.title: Celebrate 20 Years of Forza Motorsport with Fujimi Kaido
notes.content:
[h1]Where Dreams Are Driven[/h1]

It’s almost 20 years since the release of the first Forza Motorsport game. This moment was the beginning of a multi-decade journey to turn car lovers into gamers, and gamers into car lovers, one that would eventually lead us to the vibrant community we have today – a community driven by car passion, racing skills, competition and creativity.

Over the years that followed our debut game in 2005, we continued exploring our vision of creating innovative and immersive automotive experiences with the release of Forza Motorsport 2, 3, and 4 on Xbox 360; Forza Motorsport 5, 6, and 7 on Xbox One, and most recently, Forza Motorsport on Xbox Series X|S and PC.

With less than two months until the 20th anniversary, today we are excited to share with you a preview of the content that will be available in Forza Motorsport as part of our May update, which includes the eagerly awaited return of a track considered truly legendary in the Forza community.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/1dd94a4fcc1133818ab8065cd01f2faf425dc294.png[/img]

Since the release of Forza Motorsport in October 2023, our team has been fully recreating Fujimi Kaido to modern standards in our biggest track project ever! Race and drift on the Full Circuit or Full Circuit Reverse that stretches 10.24 miles (16.5 km) in length featuring 144 extreme turns and a 2,711-foot (826 meters) summit.

Our goal is to recapture the magic of drifting with your friends on the massive stretches of serpentine Japanese mountain roads at Fujimi Kaido, and we can’t wait for you to slide sideways once again as we now work to refine and polish this Forza original track for integration into the game this May.

Fujimi Kaido is only the start of our upcoming anniversary content in Forza Motorsport. There are also some highly requested cars coming to the game, in addition to unlockable driver suits, special events in both Career and Featured Multiplayer, new themed Rivals challenges, and more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/65b0f7c93c666849f8210f5f0c2234af6f6cfb38.png[/img]

We will have more to share about the Forza Motorsport 20th anniversary as we approach the release of the update in May. Stay tuned to our @ForzaMotorsport social channels on [url=https://www.facebook.com/forzamotorsport/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/forzamotorsport/]Instagram,[/url] [url=https://www.youtube.com/@Forza]YouTube,[/url] [url=https://discord.gg/forza]Discord[/url], and[url=https://twitter.com/ForzaMotorsport] X (formerly Twitter)[/url] for those details, where you can also let us know your favorite Forza Motorsport memories by using #ForzaMotorsport20.

Plus, [url=https://forza.net/newsletter]subscribe to the Forza Newsletter[/url] to be informed about everything that’s happening both in the game and our community – you will also receive the bonus Otherworld Driver Suit in Forza Motorsport just for signing up.

It's been an incredible 20 years of racing and drifting. We look forward to sharing this anniversary with you, our players – let’s celebrate this milestone together on the track in Forza Motorsport.

notes.title: Experience Unrelenting Speed in Forza Motorsport
notes.content:
Get ready to race! Velocity Month in Forza Motorsport invites you to become a master of speed and cornering using some of the most advanced cars ever manufactured. 

Obtain and race in several new-to-Motorsport cars, built to showcase the technical breakthroughs of high-performance engines when paired with cutting-edge aerodynamics. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/4fbcba05ed55aca7c36aa3f209eaccfbced83896.png[/img]
Over the next four weeks, Velocity Month introduces four Spotlight cars to the Showroom, three of which are new-to-Motorsport. These include the 2024 Lamborghini SC63, 2020 Oreca #38 Performance Tech Motorsports Oreca 07, 2023 Porsche 911 GT3 RS, and the returning 2015 Koenigsegg One:1. In addition, the new-to-Motorsport 2014 Cadillac CTS-V Sport Wagon is now available to acquire from the Showroom! 

Challenge Hub rewards for Velocity Month includes four new-to-Motorsport cars. Complete the Featured Tour to add the ultra-sleek 2021 Lamborghini Countach LPI 800-4 to your garage and the Open Class Tour to get the 2018 Lotus Evora GT430. Meanwhile, this month’s Rivals Challenges will score you the breathtaking 2024 Lamborghini Revuelto and the 1975 Forsberg Racing Nissan 'Gold Leader' Datsun 280Z. Both of these cars can also be purchased from the Showroom using credits. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/86e7c53d73d3c03cb73de928fafbd29d0e9cdd80.png[/img]
Dress up for the occasion in the Good Luck Suit and Cosmic Suit – acquirable from the Challenge Hub during Velocity Month! 

[h2]Game Improvements and Release Notes [/h2]

Forza Motorsport Update 18 rolls out for download starting Monday, March 10 on Xbox Series X|S and PC via the Microsoft Store and Steam. Spotlight cars and new in-game events will begin on Wednesday, March 12 starting at 5:00 PM PT (12:00 AM UTC on Thursday, March 13). 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/71fbd30b17ec1538056a9e450f1640953e0c1e90.png[/img]
Below is an overview of the changes and improvements included with Update 18: 
[list]
[*] We've made improvements to Multiplayer matchmaking services in Forza Motorsport with the intended effect of improving population of lobbies. [url=https://forza.net/insiders]We recently tested these changes with participants in our Forza Insiders Program[/url] and are now rolling them out to all players with Update 18. 
[*] For some HDR displays, the game would automatically configure its HDR Brightness value below 1,000 nits which made the highlights in the image look flat and clamped. The fix prevents the game from automatically configuring the value below 1,000 even if the display metadata reports that its peak luminance is under 1,000. 
[*] Increased race duration of ‘Short’ length races from 8 minutes to 10 minutes in Featured Multiplayer. Also, we’ve updated the Event schedule timing for ‘Short’ and ‘Medium’ length races to slightly increase the amount of time between races based on player feedback. 
[*] We’ve enabled the Lap counter in the HUD during Timed Races, which includes Practice as well as Multi-Class Races for easier lap tracking. In addition, Last Lap / Best Lap has also been enabled in the HUD during Timed and Multi-Class Races. 
[/list]
[url=https://aka.ms/FMUpdate18RN]Go to Forza Support to review the full release notes. [/url]
[h2]Defy Speed Boundaries in the Velocity Tour[/h2] 

Compete in the Velocity Tour and experience an unforgettable journey of cutting-edge automobiles across four series: Lamborghini LMDh, Sebring LMP2, Production to GT, and Extreme Speed. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/b739186d9d8b00b29b09ad3696fbfd57c38a9339.png[/img]
[h3]Lamborghini LMDh [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/b7530f7bfe774c8c1d6ed1c0fae475874450abf2.png[/img]
Experience the next generation of advanced Lamborghini racing with the 2024 Lamborghini SC63, a car developed through an exciting collaboration between Lamborghini and Ligier. 

[h3]Sebring LMP2 [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/b9e41bbfc1cd59b13de4e7389b83d6dfb53343f3.png[/img]
Compete in an endurance racing series inspired by the 12 Hours of Sebring! Push your skill, endurance and stamina to maintain velocity in the 2020 #38 Performance Tech Motorsports Oreca 07 on Sebring International Raceway for an entire hour! 

[h3]Production to GT [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/ff6899d95ceab321028ef440c4ceb0fa35a92d54.png[/img]
Celebrate this legacy of Porsche racing by driving the 2023 Porsche 911 GT3 RS and rival the current velocity of sports car racers. 

[h3]Extreme Speed[/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/151586c481df28c2e2fae1ab6ca3fde947caace8.png[/img]
There’s no better way to conclude your journey in the Velocity Tour than with the first homologated car in the world with a power-to-weight ratio of 1:1. Step into the extremely rare 2015 Koenigsegg One:1 and experience its truly staggering speed on the racetrack.  

Complete all four series in the Velocity Tour in Career before April 23, 2025, to unlock the new-to-Motorsport 2021 Lamborghini Countach LPI 800-4 from the Challenge Hub. This car is also obtainable by completing 10 races in the Velocity Series in Featured Multiplayer. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/a3e31704af0ef3e1186d237f42ae7ac647d1eb06.png[/img]
[h2]Race Your Favorite Cars in the Open Tour [/h2]

Once you have mastered the speed and power of the Velocity Tour, check out the Open Class Tour to continue the journey of these cars. Available under the Featured tab in Career mode. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/1047e9895211b121b466305bfa55202f693db09d.png[/img]
Open Class Tour is where you can experiment with different upgrades and showcase your favorite tuned cars. Each update to Forza Motorsport refreshes the Open Class Tour with new events and a different reward car. Cars you’ve already upgraded in a different Builders Cup series can be further levelled up in the Open Class Tour. 

The Open Class Tour features six series, each with three races, that range from D Class to R Class. Continue upgrading your cars through each event and use them to complete all six series in the Open Class Tour before April 9, 2025, and you will receive the 2018 Lotus Evora GT430. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/e29576b86fc41cacb1c85eec3ea5b517a848d32c.png[/img]
You can also unlock this new-to-Motorsport car by completing 10 races in any Open Series in Featured Multiplayer.

Spotlight cars are featured in the Showroom every week. These cars correspond to the available in-game events and can be acquired with a temporary 30% discount using in-game credits. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/bc26171ef723ffa607d6d1165727c7ffd8786038.png[/img]
Velocity Month introduces four Spotlight cars to the Showroom, one per week, and three new-to-Motorsport. These Spotlight cars can be used in the Velocity Tour and Spotlight Rivals, the Velocity Series in Featured Multiplayer, as well as to complete Challenge Hub objectives.

notes.title: Update 17 – Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
[h2]Stability and Performance [All Platforms][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could restart when using the Quick Resume suspend feature on Xbox Series X|S consoles. [1773305]
[*] Fixed an issue where disconnects could happen during a fixed start at the beginning of a race. [1955275]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could get stuck in a loading screen after losing connection in a multiplayer race. [1934075]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could softlock during the sign-in flow before reaching the Homespace. [1898693]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could softlock in the post-race results screen. [1936503]
[*] Fixed an issue where liveries would be reloaded even if they were currently applied to the given car. [1681330]
[/list]
[h2]Audio [All Platforms][/h2]
Updated car audio for the following vehicles based on community feedback:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in the updated 2019 Lamborghini Sian FKP 37 exhaust sound.
[*] Fixed a bug in the updated 2021 Porsche GT3 cockpit audio.
[*] Fixed a bug where opponent cars were not being attenuated correctly in cockpit view. [1909391]
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay [All Platforms][/h2]
[list]
[*] Rivals events can now be switched quickly without causing game instability. [1945817]
[*] An improved Rival select system changes how friends and random players are prioritized as your Next Rival when there are no more friends to beat on the event’s leaderboard or when your next friend's best lap time is exceedingly faster than yours, while ensuring each new Rival presents a decent challenge. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the crowd sizes could be incorrect for some races. [1887293]
[/list]
[h2]Featured Multiplayer [All Platforms][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in both Featured Multiplayer and Private Multiplayer during the Grid Preview before each race where the driver character and cars would flicker when players are adjusting Fuel or Tire settings. [1800311]
[*] Fixed an issue where the 1988 #77 Beretta Trans Am was incorrectly eligible for the BMW Challenge Series. [1960071]
[*] Fixed an issue where selecting a driver suit would cause the player's driver to flicker during a multiplayer race. [1800311]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would become unstable when trying to enter an event for A Class cars in Featured Multiplayer. [1956418]
[*] Fixed an issue that could occur when retrieving the Featured Multiplayer schedule while receiving an update. [1792306]
[*] Fixed a crash present when attempting to enter certain events without an applicable car in Featured Multiplayer. [1956362]
[*] Updated the track rotation in the Forza GT2 Spec Series based on player feedback.

notes.title: Discover Your Next Daily Racer in Forza Motorsport
notes.content:
Sports cars demonstrate their versatility through performance, speed and agility. These daily racers are varied in nature, from small and agile hot hatches to roaring V8 sedans, to the new generation of electric cars. Experience the world of Daily Racers in Forza Motorsport Update 17. 

Daily Racers introduces four new-to-Motorsport cars in the Showroom: the 2023 Toyota Camry TRD, 2021 Hyundai i20 N, 2022 Toyota GR86, and the 2021 Hyundai #98 Elantra TCR. 

Challenge Hub rewards for Daily Racers includes two additional new-to-Motorsport cars, the 2021 Toyota Yaris GR – unlocked by completing the Daily Racers Tour – and the 2023 Hyundai Ioniq 5 N, which can be earned by finishing all six series in the Open Class Tour, as well as the Dreamwave and Weekend Warrior Driver Suits. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/a57aea7b5f369b99b6de0f0288691a3520185492.png[/img]

In addition, each series in the Daily Racers Tour also has its own Spotlight car, three of which are new-to-Motorsport. Add the 2020 Hyundai i30 N, 2022 Cadillac CT5V Blackwing, 2022 Mazda MX-5 RF, and 2022 Hyundai Elantra N to your car collection with a limited-time 30% discount. 

[h2]Game Improvements and Release Notes [/h2]

Forza Motorsport Update 17 rolls out for download starting Monday, February 10 on Xbox Series X|S and PC via the Microsoft Store and Steam. Spotlight cars and new in-game events will begin on Wednesday, February 12 starting at 4:00 PM PT (12:00 AM UTC on Thursday, February 13). 

Below is an overview of the changes and improvements included with Update 17: 
[list]
[*] An improved Rival select system changes how friends and random players are prioritized as your Next Rival when there are no more friends to beat on the event’s leaderboard or when your next friend's best lap time is exceedingly faster than yours, while ensuring each new Rival presents a decent challenge.   
[*] Updated car audio for the 1998 Toyota Supra RZ and 2020 Toyota GR Supra. 
[*] Fixed bugs in the updated 2019 Lamborghini Sian FKP 37 exhaust sound and 2021 Porsche GT3 cockpit audio. 
[*] Fixed a bug where opponent cars were not being attenuated correctly in cockpit view.   
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could restart when using the Quick Resume suspend feature on Xbox Series X|S consoles. 
[*] Rivals events can now be switched quickly without causing game instability. 
[/list]

With Update 17, all vehicles in the Forza Touring Car Spec Series in Featured Multiplayer have been reverted to stock parts and re-tuned with [url=https://forza.net/insiders]feedback from participants in our Forza Insiders Program[/url], many of whom were invited to playtest this update ahead of its general availability. [url=https://aka.ms/FMUpdate17RN]Please review the release notes for a detailed breakdown of the tuning changes that have been applied to each vehicle in the Forza Touring Car Spec Series. [/url]

[h2]Experience Practicality in the Daily Racers Tour [/h2]

Speed and performance should be a joy to experience anytime, anywhere. The Daily Racers Tour will allow you to discover the cars that take people to work during the week and battle it out on the track over the weekend.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/b0511b6d6dc4b2663aa044b7ff08977d577506a0.png[/img]

Across four distinct series, you will explore the world of Modern Hot Hatch, Luxury & Horsepower, RWD Roadsters, and Battle of Sedans. 

[b]Modern Hot Hatch [/b]

Start your journey in Modern Hot Hatches. Get behind the wheel of the new-to-Motorsport 2020 Hyundai i30 N and race against other Hot Hatches known to be performant on the track. 

[b]Luxury & Horsepower [/b]

The series showcases cars that combine luxury with performance. Go head-to-head with other luxury sports cars and prove which one is fastest on the track. 

[b]RWD Roadsters [/b]

Jump into an RWD Roadster. The penultimate series of the Daily Racers Tour invites you to drive the 2022 Mazda MX-5 RF and take on other roadsters in its class. 

[b]Battle of Sedans [/b]

Sport compacts are a proving ground for manufacturers competing on performance and price. Race alongside fun and powerful cars in the new-to-Motorsport 2022 Hyundai Elantra N, a vehicle which demonstrates both affordability and fun.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/33dd601c093edc30f0524604c3d887a9f6297ce8.png[/img]

Complete all four series in the Daily Racers Tour in Career before March 26, 2025, to unlock the new-to-Motorsport 2021 Toyota Yaris GR from the Challenge Hub. This car is also obtainable by completing 10 races in the Daily Racers Series in Featured Multiplayer. 

[h2]Test Your Daily Racers in the Open Class Tour [/h2]

Once you have experienced the diverse lineup of Daily Racers in Forza Motorsport, check out the Open Class Tour to continue the journey of these cars. Available under the Featured tab in Career mode. 

Open Class Tour is where you can experiment with different upgrades and showcase your favorite tuned cars. Each update to Forza Motorsport refreshes the Open Class Tour with new events and a different reward car. Cars you’ve already upgraded in a different Builders Cup series can be further levelled up in the Open Class Tour. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/668c4d5f3cc84895223090ad995bc46d0bb681c4.png[/img]

The Open Class Tour features six series, each with three races, that range from D Class to R Class. Upgrade your Daily Racers and use them to complete all six series in the Open Class Tour before March 12, 2025, and you will receive the 2023 Hyundai Ioniq 5 N. 

You can also unlock this new-to-Motorsport car by completing 10 races in any Open Series in Featured Multiplayer. 

[h2]Spotlight Cars and VIP Discounts [/h2]

Spotlight cars are featured in the Showroom every week. These cars correspond to the available in-game events and can be acquired with a temporary 30% discount using in-game credits. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/0bf0a333d0c23a89b64cc8cd2375444fc604ae15.png[/img]

Daily Racers Month showcases four Spotlight cars in the Showroom, one per week, and three new-to-Motorsport. These Spotlight cars can be used in the Daily Racers Tour and Spotlight Rivals, the Daily Racers Series in Featured Multiplayer, as well as to complete Challenge Hub objectives.

notes.title: Race into 2025 with BMW Month in Forza Motorsport
notes.content:
Start the New Year with a celebration! Immerse yourself in the automotive world of BMW in Forza Motorsport Update 16, whose reputation for automotive excellence traces back to its storied history in motorsport. 

BMW Month is also your chance to Race to Le Mans! Get behind the wheel of the 2023 #25 BMW Team RLL M Hybrid V8 and complete 15 laps at Daytona International Speedway to unlock the car competing in the 24-hour race. [url=https://b.mw/racetolemans]Register for a chance to win a trip to Le Mans. [/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/a5aa6c09bdb30e06f957b33b5afee5ff4bcd58af.png[/img]

[url=https://forza.net/newsletter]Sign up for the Forza Newsletter[/url] to stay informed about the latest updates in Forza games. [url=https://forza.net/insiders]Join the Forza Insiders Program[/url] for an exclusive opportunity to playtest future Forza Motorsport updates before they get released for everyone. Meet and chat with likeminded players in our [url=https://discord.gg/forza]Forza Discord server[/url], and follow @ForzaMotorsport channels on[url=https://www.facebook.com/forzamotorsport/] Facebook,[/url] [url=https://www.instagram.com/forzamotorsport/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@Forza]YouTube[/url], and [url=https://twitter.com/ForzaMotorsport]X (formerly Twitter)[/url] to stay up to date with the latest in-game events and community updates. [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@forzamotorsport]We’re also now on TikTok! [/url]

[h2]Game Improvements and Release Notes [/h2]

Forza Motorsport Update 16 rolls out for download starting Monday, January 6 on Xbox Series X|S and PC via the Microsoft Store and Steam. Spotlight cars and new in-game events will begin on Wednesday, January 8 starting at 4:00 PM PT (12:00 AM UTC on Thursday, January 9). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/85f186765135b10cd3f397f9ba4e13724758326e.png[/img]

Below is an overview of the changes and improvements included with Update 16: 

[list]
[*] Update 16 introduces a number of car balancing changes for Featured Multiplayer Spec Series. These include specific tuning adjustments to the new BMW cars featured in BMW Month, as well as tweaks to the existing 2023 Cadillac #01 Cadillac Racing V-Series.R, 2021 Cadillac #31 Whelen Racing DPi-V.R, 2024 Porsche #5 Porsche Penske Motorsport 963, and 2020 Acura #6 ARX-05 DPi.  
[list][*] [url=http://aka.ms/FMUpdate16RN]Head on over to Forza Support to view the full release notes, which include a detailed overview of the balancing changes we’ve made to each vehicle. [/url]
[/list][*] Based on community feedback, we have enhanced cockpit audio for the 2021 Porsche 911 GT3 and updated overall car sounds for the 2002 Ferrari Enzo Ferrari. 
[*] Original in-game branding has been restored on Homestead-Miami Speedway, Hakone, Maple Valley, and in the player Homespace.  
[/list]

If you encounter any issues while playing Forza Motorsport or enjoying Update 16 content, [url=https://aka.ms/THUB]they can be reported on the Troubleshooting Hub[/url]. Please be sure to include any reproduction steps to help our team investigate, and if another player has reported a similar problem, you can upvote their topic to help bring additional visibility to it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/32f85fd04fbe536fcb34444c8a83884ece1e5354.png[/img]

We’re also eager to hear your ideas for the cars, tracks and features you would like to see in future Forza Motorsport updates. [url=https://aka.ms/SHUB]Those can be posted to our Suggestions Hub on the forums[/url], where you can also upvote existing topics shared by the community. Many of the updates released in 2024 were directly inspired by player input, so please keep the feedback coming! 

[h2]Discover a Storied Legacy in the BMW Tour [/h2]

BMW is renowned for crafting vehicles that seamlessly blend track-bred technology with luxurious refinement, and their unwavering commitment to motorsport extends beyond mere competition. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/c78ea8062c659a2834f717453be74f0a61d1faa4.png[/img]

BMW Month invites you to discover how the racetrack serves as a laboratory for the world-famous German manufacturer, where it develops new technology and pushes the boundaries of automotive engineering.  

Experience the legacy and present-day prestige of BMW Motorsport in the BMW Tour, featuring four distinct series of races for you to complete: Early M, BMW Motorsport GT, Modern M, and BMW Motorsport Endurance.  

[h3]Early M [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/9d4a02ff75e323fe5a94fc5814a95f71e77851d8.png[/img]

The legendary BMW M division, born from a desire to dominate motorsport, has become synonymous with high-performance driving. Start your journey with Early M Touring Cars from the mid-1980s, featuring the 1986 BMW M635 CSi.   

[h3]BMW Motorsport GT [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/b4e15185d7f868b4c83eb05e5ee4f9a739b3787a.png[/img]

Race in the 2018 BMW #1 BMW M Motorsport M8 GTE and beat out your competition in endurance races that celebrate the modern era of BMW Motorsport GT.   

[h3]Modern M [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/5a1fade602ec26648843111b1e772ab158dd9531.png[/img]

Production cars are at the heart of BMW. Choose between the 2019 BMW Z4 Roadster or 2014 BMW M4 Coupe and race their rivals from the mid-2010s.   

[h3]BMW Motorsport Endurance [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/d12028d89cd5590275c68b61f1a00e0bf8a2b3d5.png[/img]

Get behind the wheel of the 1999 BMW #15 BMW Motorsport V12 LMR and battle it out with other Petit Le Mans cars from the same era. 

[h3]BMW Tour Reward [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/4a39a825af3c4a740601b555204da58025db727e.png[/img]

Complete all four series in the BMW Tour in Career before February 26, 2025, to unlock the new-to-Motorsport 2023 BMW #96 Turner Motorsports M4 GT3 from the Challenge Hub. This car is also obtainable by completing 10 races in the BMW Challenge Series in Featured Multiplayer.  

[h3]Upgrade Your BMWs in the Open Tour [/h3]

Once you have got to grips with the diverse legacy of BMW Motorsport in Forza Motorsport, check out the Open Class Tour to continue the journey of your favorite BMW cars. Available under the Featured tab in Career mode.    

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/b3d0b6711f6850ec359ba10d5a50edd25144dbfd.png[/img]

Open Class Tour is where you can experiment with different upgrades and showcase your favorite tuned cars. Each update to Forza Motorsport refreshes the Open Class Tour with new events and a different reward car. Cars you’ve already upgraded in a different Builders Cup series can be further levelled up in the Open Class Tour.    

The Open Class Tour features six series, each with three races, that range from D Class to R Class. Upgrade your BMWs – or any other cars of your choosing – and use them to complete all six series in the Open Class Tour before February 12, 2025, and you will receive the 1976 #1 BMW 3.0 CSL.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/f7b5850ab5cf89f8f1a98d99765bd566befe93ad.png[/img]

You can also unlock this new-to-Motorsport car by completing 10 races in any Open Series in Featured Multiplayer.  

[h3]Claim Your Mobil 1 Livery Gift [/h3]

We’ve teamed up with our partners at Cadilliac and Mobil 1 to bring you an exclusive new design for the 2023 Cadillac #01 Cadillac Racing V-Series.R, and as the cover car of Forza Motorsport, we wanted to ensure this one would be special.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/ae40b17604ef86bc836e6272235ba78a3dd06df7.png[/img]

Available now with the release of Update 16, a new Mobil 1 50th Anniversary Gold Livery has been gifted to all Forza Motorsport players. Look for the in-game popup to confirm your reward and go to the “My Designs” menu to apply this unique look to the iconic racecar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/9ee907a6c1f641ac56604d6df617178f6899ad48.png[/img]

Expand your collection with the new-to-Motorsport 2023 BMW #25 BMW Team RLL M Hybrid V8 and 2020 Formula Drift #91 BMW M2 – both of which can also be unlocked in the Challenge Hub.  

In addition, you will also find the 2010 BMW M6 Coupe, 2009 BMW M5, 2008 BMW M3, and 2003 BMW M5 available to purchase with credits in the Showroom. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/ae75fd5c8480fecc319dc8ff1f54671c22cb1c69.png[/img]

Look forward to the 2014 BMW M4 Coupe and 1999 BMW #15 BMW Motorsport V12 LMR, which will be featured as Spotlight cars during BMW Month.
