[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/89ee69395da14b0b9f37a2b6f7b5dccc377048b5.png[/img]

[h2]Compete in the BMW Challenge Series [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/cdc66d1c4eb8b19c9f673dbe068ddb56f1c577d8.png[/img]

In the second week of BMW Month, you can also compete in a series voted on and determined by you, the Forza Community! [url=https://aka.ms/forzaforums]Head over to the Forza Forums to make your voice heard in a future update![/url] This month, the winning restrictions were: Modern Sport GT Division, Max 800 PI, Medium Race Length (~20 minutes). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/88be66e08131ea867304d36a86df7c6687e894d3.png[/img]

Later in the month, look forward to a multi-class re-imagining of the classic Forza GT series where you can discover the unique strengths that each Forza GT class brings to the track. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/1bac96d51523b951c724dfdf6d56c011af812d66.png[/img]

[url=https://b.mw/racetolemans]Register here for a chance to win a trip for two to Le Mans[/url] (including flights, accommodation and tickets) courtesy of BMW M Motorsport.

This week is your final chance to set your best time in the Logitech McLaren G Challenge Qualifier #2. Race the 1988 McLaren MP4/4 at Silverstone – Grand Prix Circuit. You have until January 15 to participate.  

Starting on January 16, get ready to enter the Logitech McLaren G Challenge Qualifier #3 featuring the 2013 McLaren P1 hypercar at Watkins Glen – Full Circuit. notes.title: 2024 Forza Year in Review
notes.content:
[h2]Introduction [/h2]

2024 has been one of Forza’s busiest years yet, as both Forza Horizon 5 and Forza Motorsport continue to receive regular feature and content updates from our developers at Playground Games and Turn 10 Studios.  

With so many game updates to keep up with, this year we launched the [url=https://forza.net/newsletter]Forza Newsletter[/url], a periodic notification service that delivers the latest Forza news to your email inbox. Whether you prefer exploring offroad vistas, zooming through chicanes on circuits, or even doing both kinds of racing, there’s something for everyone in the [url=https://forza.net/newsletter]Forza Newsletter[/url]. (Psst... keep an eye out, and you might find some in-game goodies in a future newsletter...) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/2fc08563d1e161adb5dbaf6e5596f77e2163249c.png[/img]
[i]Livery by JDMADIAZ[/i]

[h2]Forza Community[/h2]

Cars and community—a combination made possible by game developers and game players, together. The Forza team is continuously inspired by the out-of-the-box and thoughtful creations made by the millions of Forza players across our games. While we’ve shared some examples in this article, our complete “Best of 2024” collections on the forums will let you peruse some of our favorite photos and livery designs. You may find a new signature look for your favorite car, or maybe you’ll be inspired to start creating and sharing your own in-game artistic talents! 
[list]
[*] [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/best-of-2024-in-fh5-photos/749897]Best of the year in FH5 Photos [/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/best-of-2024-in-fh5-liveries/749895]Best of the year in FH5 Liveries [/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/best-of-2024-in-fm-photos/749988]Best of the year in FM Photos [/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/best-of-2024-in-fm-liveries/749989]Best of the year in FM Liveries [/url]
[/list]

Forza Horizon 5 players--there’s still time to [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/official-fh5-golden-tank-awards-2024-vote-now/749234]vote for your favorite EventLab creations in this year’s Golden Tank Awards![/url] These fantastical and elaborate races, obstacle courses, puzzles, adventures, and tracks continue to evolve in quality as more players try their hand at building their own blueprint and placing props.  

2024 was also the year of creative UGC collaborations. Livery artist PTG Fluex and EventLab expert JohCee came together to produce "Miniracers," a project featuring four unique EventLab creations designed to evoke the charm of racing vintage toy cars in nostalgic and whimsical environments, with liveries inspired by classic toy cars. 

The collaborations went far beyond just individual players teaming up; one example is the fan groups Forza Street Wars and the Forza Creators Guild, who partnered to create compelling competitive courses that highlighted the technical skills of EventLab builders while challenging the racers of Street Wars tournaments with exciting and unfamiliar terrain. 

Arguably, the biggest Forza Motorsport community event of 2024 was the 9 Hours of Kyalami World Cup, hosted by TORA (The Online Racing Association) and featuring over 100 teams, with 350+ individual drivers. And yes, they all really raced for 9 whole hours! Congratulations to ESV Motorsports! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/df4e5911fb1a554794006c3df60d0146d717d711.png[/img]
[i]Livery by FormFirm
[/i]
[h2]Forza Motorsport[/h2] 

2024 was a steady year of progress for Forza Motorsport. Between 12 content updates, the game bolstered its lineup of cars and tracks, while also introducing several new features and quality of life improvements, [url=https://aka.ms/SHUB]many of which were inspired by the community voting on Suggestions Hub. 
[/url]
Some of the notable track highlights over the past year include Nürburgring Nordschleife, Sebring International Raceway, Road Atlanta, [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-13]Sunset Peninsula – last featured in Forza Motorsport 4[/url] – and most recently, Mount Panorama Circuit, Bathurst – home of the V8 Supercars Championship. 

Many new and returning cars were also added to the game, such as the 2024 Next-Gen NASCAR, 2024 Ford Mustang RTR, 2019 Ginetta G40 Junior, 2018 Aston Martin #97 AMR Vantage GTE, 2018 Saleen S302 Black Label, 1988 Chevrolet #77 Beretta Trans Am, and even more.   

There have been improvements to overall stability and performance, new game modes like Drift, Endurance and Multi-Class, and a host of new feature additions, including Car Proximity Radar, Spectate, Practice & Qualifying in Private Multiplayer, Advanced Car Ghosting, and more. [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-12]With Challenge Hub, it became possible to earn reward cars by playing either the Career or Featured Multiplayer,[/url] and we’ve continued making updates to other aspects of the game, including visual fidelity and audio quality, Drivatar AI, Forza Race Regulations, and Driver & Safety Ratings. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/b67b884db70d3fae2d3ef430675e645d088d8d83.png[/img]
[i]Photo by FRT Davi[/i]

As we work towards the future of Forza Motorsport, we started some new community initiatives this year to help ensure we’re going in the right direction. [url=https://forza.net/news/motorsport-community-august-2024]Our team has been sharing progress updates in our letters to the community[/url], and [url=https://forza.net/news/in-the-garage-frr-discord-ama]we kicked off a new “In the Garage” Discord AMA[/url] series to allow our developers to go deeper into the areas of the game that you care the most about.  

We also opened the Forza Insiders Program where you can [url=https://forza.net/insiders]sign up for the opportunity to participate in playtests[/url] of future Forza Motorsport updates on PC or console as well as share your opinions on game content in feedback surveys and our exclusive forums. 

We’ve celebrated [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-14]numerous partnerships throughout 2024[/url], including Mobil 1 – [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-8]with new Rivals challenges and a rebranding of Maple Valley[/url] – as well as Logitech, McLaren, and NASCAR. An undoubtable highlight was our sneaker collaboration with Jordan and professional basketball player Luka Dončić. This included a rendition of Hakone featuring the iconic Jordan brand, and all players were sent a custom 1969 Chevrolet Camaro Jordan Luka 3 Motorsport Edition. Players can compete in the Jordan Luka 3 Motorsport Series using this car – inspired by the shoe – to unlock a special racing suit, and [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-gamescom-2024]we also made the vehicle available to everyone playing Forza Horizon 5. [/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/5461975ba7fb0ba1ca60963fab5c11c6570f28e4.png[/img]
[i]Photo by Kerles[/i]

[h2]Forza Horizon 5 [/h2]

Never thought we could dribble around the roads of the Horizon Festival in a car like the 1969 Chevrolet Camaro Jordan Luka 3 Motorsport Edition, but 2024 was a year with a ton of surprises coming to Forza Horizon 5 that we hope you enjoyed and will keep enjoying while adventuring through Mexico.  

We kicked off the year with [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-Community-Choice]Community Choice[/url], a content update done partially with members of our community. Our players got the chance to vote which cars, features, and decorations they wanted to see back into the game. The votes were tallied, and the result was a series filled with neon lights at Aeródromo en la Selva, 16 returning stunts, 10 reward cars added to the Autoshow, and a Festival Playlist packed with European Exotics. 

That’s not the only time our community came together for an update. Back in March, the [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-Horizon-Race-Off]Horizon Race-off went live[/url]. This update gave our players a collaborative goal: complete street and off-road racing events to unlock two cars for the entire community! A new traveling outpost made its way to the Horizon Festival this series too. The Race-Off Outpost showed players progress on both the street and off-roading challenges, but the past part of this new feature is that it changed its location every week allowing players to explore the map to find it. 

Two months after the Race-Off, a wave of retro vibes took over the Horizon Festival with [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-horizon-retrowave]Horizon Retrowave[/url]. This content update featured a new start screen players saw (and many chose as their favorite) as soon as the game booted with the update. The Retrowave wasn’t only about the looks, but also the sounds. Forza Horizon 5 welcomed a new synthwave radio station: Horizon Wave. Hosted by Isabel Moss, the new station featured 21 new songs including a streamer friendly “Encanto Remix” by Mitch Murder.  

An exciting new game mode came to Forza Horizon 5 this year on the [url=https://aka.ms/FH5HiddenHorizons]Hidden Horizons[/url] update along with all the cars and content: Hide & Seek. This new 5v1 experience had players enjoy a thrilling game of chase between two teams. 5 players joined the game as the Seekers whose job is to find and stay close to the Hider in order to fill their meter. If the meter reached 100% before time runs out or before the Seeker reaches their destination, they took home the win! On the other side, Hiders had to use the environment and NPC cars to cover themselves and stay hidden from the Seekers until the End Zone location was revealed to all players. When the End Zone is revealed, their mission becomes to reach that location before Hiders complete their meter. The following game update, [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-back-to-the-90s]Back to the 90’s[/url], gave players the opportunity to unlock accolades and achievements related to Hide & Seek. We hope you still enjoy hiding and chasing as much as we have! 

EventLab creators had a great time this year with all the props added to the game that ranges from coffee cups, racing decorations, highways, elevation pieces, and of course the new Halo props that came in the [url=https://aka.ms/FH5HorizonTrackDay]Horizon Track Day[/url]. Our largest Prop Pack ever featured 71 pieces with iconic structures from the Halo franchise such as the Covenant Barricade, UNSC Barricade, Covenant Drop Pod, Energy Shield, Covenant Crate, UNSC Pelican, and more. Most of these pieces came directly from Halo Studios, bringing them right out of Forge Mode and into the Horizon Festival. Three songs from Halo’s OST were also added to the game during this series to FH5’s radio stations. Horizon XS now plays the Halo Theme Gungnir Mix (feat. Steve Vai) and Radio Eterna added Installation 04 and The Trails to its catalogue. 

Forza Horizon 5 saw an amazing set of car packs with a large variety of cars, including EVs, superstar racers, pop culture icons, and more. One of our community’s favorites was the [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-modern-horizons]Universal Icons Car Pack[/url], which included 5 cars from TV shows and movies: 3 versions of the Back to the Future Time Machine with movie-like lights and sounds, the 1982 Universal Studios K.I.T.T. (featuring the Super Pursuit Bodykit), and the iconic 1992 Universal Studios Jeep Wrangler Sahara ‘Jurassic Park.’ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/a0eff52cbb068a6bf5be2fd29c7e3a92ca35384d.png[/img]

[h2]A Fond Farewell to Forza Horizon 4 [/h2]

By the time this article is published, Forza Horizon 4 will no longer be available for purchase at online stores. However, the game is still completely playable, and the game’s servers are still running, so you can still hop in and explore Britain’s beautiful landscapes with other players in the open world! Remember that if you played Forza Horizon 4 on Xbox Game Pass and bought any DLC content for the game, you may be eligible for a game token that you can still redeem. [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-4-delisting]Please take a look at our blog post for more information. [/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/90219e2205f8c08a80cdd195ab77a16482b1b40e.png[/img]

[h2]Conclusion [/h2]

In the grand scheme of time, 2024’s coming and going marks 19 years since the release of the very first Forza game. That’s right—2025 is Forza’s 20th anniversary, and we’re planning some fun activities and surprises for the whole Forza community next year.  

Thanks for racing with us this year, and we’ll see you on the road in 2025!

notes.title: Unlock the Frostbite Suit, the Rebellious Suit, and the Otherworld Driver Suit
notes.content:
Three suits are up for grabs, the winter-themed Frostbite Suit and the yellow Rebellious Suit.

[h2]Frostbite Suit[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/c49338b7e63c49b2ed74ab1d20abd01b1e0e85fa.png[/img]

Unlock the winter-themed Frostbite Suit by completing a lap in the 2019 Elemental Rp1 on Nürburgring Nordschleife in the Rain. This white suit and helmet have black and red accents and are covered throughout with icicles in teal tones.

[h2]Rebellious Suit[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/27aa7491335d0db9106a9a42ea18c898e7ee656b.png[/img]

Complete 10 clean laps at Bathurst in an Australian car to get the yellow Rebellious Suit in the Challenge Hub! This clean driver gear features black and green accents in lightning patterns.

[h2]Otherworld Driver Suit[/h2]

Sign up to the [url=forza.net/newsletter]Forza Newsletter[/url]. Get monthly updates across the whole world of Forza delivered straight to your inbox and receive an exclusive in-game driver suit.

notes.title: Update 15: Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
[h2]Stability and Performance [All Platforms] [/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would crash when entering a Multi-Class Race in Free Play. [1539013] 
[*] Faster transition between car views when using Spectate in Private Multiplayer or watching Replays. [1874035] 
[*] The game should no longer soft lock when players exit a Free Play Multi-Class Race before Drivatar loading finishes. [1806966] 
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would crash in very rare cases, when changing options on Multi-Class Free Play Races [1877525] 
[*] Fixed a crash that sometimes occurred when starting a Rivals race. [1584200] 
[*] The game no longer crashes when accepting a Private Multiplayer join request while saving livery groups or designs in the Livery Editor. [1901378] 
[/list]
[h2]PC [/h2]
[list]
[*] Improvements have been made to better balance the rendering work across more cores when possible, resulting in better Render CPU FPS on entry to mid-tier CPUs and possibly better GPU FPS depending on the system.
[/list]
[h2]Audio [All Platforms] [/h2]
[list][*]Updated car audio for the following vehicles based on community feedback: 
[list][*]1991 BMW M3 
[*]1994 Ferrari F355 Berlinetta 
[*]2013 Ferrari La Ferrari 
[*]2015 Ferrari F12 TDF 
[*]2017 Ferrari 812 Superfast 
[*]2015 McLaren P1 GTR[/list][/list]

We recently shared details about how we updated our authoring techniques and pipelines so that we can fix as many car audio issues as possible. [url=https://forza.net/news/in-the-garage-audio-discord-ama]Please read this blog for additional details regarding our approach to future car audio updates in Forza Motorsport.[/url]

[h2]Gameplay [All Platforms] [/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where certain cars would be ghosted in the First Cup race. [1878447]  
[*] Fixed an issue where the player would become soft locked if they drove into the pit lane during the First Cup on Hakone. [1883718] 
[/list]
[h2]Featured Multiplayer [All Platforms] [/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the race end countdown could start at the beginning of a race, ending the race pre-maturely. [1693311] 
[*] Added new Forza AUS Series featuring Bathurst exclusively for the duration of Update 15. 
[*] Swapped out Vintage Le Man Prototypes and Vintage Le Mans Sportscars events for Forza AUS events in the Endurance Series for Update 15. 
[*] Road to Race Series makes a return with new Road/Race car combinations. 
[*] Added the Nordschleife / Nürburgring Full Circuit to the following Open Class Series: 
[list]
[*] Multi-Class Series - Nordschleife  
[*] A Class Series - Nordschleife  
[*] S Class Series - Nordschleife  
[*] R Class Series – Nürburgring Full Circuit  
[*] Cycled Class Series (P Class, X Class) – Nürburgring Full Circuit [/list]
[*]Enabled Rolling Starts for all events in the following Featured MP Series:  
[list]
[*] Forza GT2 Series  
[*] Forza GT3 Series  
[*] Early LMP Series  
[*] Forza P1 Series  
[*] Forza Proto-H Series  
[*] Formula Mazda Series  
[*] Endurance Series (excluding Forza AUS events)[/list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the wrong player information would be displayed during walk-the-grid. [1829185]  
[*]Set correct initial Fuel adjustments when starting a Practice or Qualifying race. [1877402]  
[*]Prevented players who had just switched from Practice to Qualifying from briefly appearing in the wrong position on track for players who were already in Qualifying. [1714748]  
[/list]
[h2]Featured Multiplayer Car Balancing Changes [All Platforms] [/h2]
[b]2022 Pagani Huayra R [/b]
[list][*]Added to & tuned within the Modern 
[*]Factory Racecar Series Spec 
[list][*]Decreased Engine Torque by 5% (from stock) 
[*]Increased Drag by 30% (from stock) 
[*]Added 7.5% weight ballast (from stock) [/list][/list]

[h2]Private Multiplayer [All Platforms]  [/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a stability issue occurring while exiting a Private Multiplayer Drift Event on Steam. [1890464] 
[*] Fixed an issue where the end of race timer in Drift mode would start only after the last driver has crossed the finish line. [1874069] 
[*] Added a "host driving" and "host spectating" icon so players can always identify who is the host in Private Multiplayer events.  [1795249] 
[*] Fixed disconnected players showing up on track during the race start sequence for all of the Race Start Types; Fixed disconnected players showing up on track for the entirety of a race whilst spectating. [1901106] 
[*] Fixed an issue where upon performing a Rolling Start on a slope the cars would appear to be dropped onto the track. [1896372] 
[*] Fixed an issue where the Spectate or Quit Spectate button would not update properly. [1881215] 
[*] Fixed an issue where other player's cars could appear to get stuck in the pits during Practice & Qualifying. [1902788] 
[*] Improved title stability around Private Meetup games when players switch to Meetup game types from other Game Types. [1909417] 
[*] Players will no longer time out or disconnect if the host changes the Race Type while they're in a post-meetup cinematic. [1903881] 
[*] Fixed an issue where rejoining Spectate mode would cause the spectated car to turn invisible. [1874593] 
[*] Players are now brought back to Mobile HQ from the pit cinematic if the host changes event settings while they are entering Practice or Qualifying. [1898687] 
[*] Fixed an issue where race options would disappear when the host would disable Practice & Qualify while players were in practice or qualify. [1917758] 
[*] The pre-race Spectate button's visibility should now be properly updated for players as the host changes between Game Types. [1912549] 
[/list]
[h2]Photo Mode [All Platforms] [/h2]
[list][*]Fixed a bug where the Photo Mode camera could break beyond defined boundaries in the Homespace and be navigated around the car bay area. 
[list][*]Developers Note: We recognize that this was a popular capability for some photographers in our community, however it was the result of a bug that we needed to fix as leaving it in the game would create problems in future updates. With that said, we are keen to understand how much interest you have in this functionality being developed into a feature and officially implemented into the game. We have set up this thread on the Suggestions Hub where you can upvote the idea and share your thoughts and experiences with us. Thank you for your understanding as we worked through this one![/list][/list]

[h2]Livery Editor & UGC [All Platforms] [/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where canceling the upgrade flow in car select wouldn't bring you back to the car select menu. [1906791]  
[*] Fixed an occasional crash when downloading liveries and tunes for Drivatars. [1867332, 1873135]  
[*] Fixed an occasional soft lock when quick upgrading your car from the pre-race menu. [1891711] 
[/list]
[h2]UI [All Platforms] [/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing "(GroupText)" to sometimes show up in the podium cinematic. [1906361]  
[*] The driver’s list column names in Private Multiplayer now matches the event setup in Drift mode. [1872914]  
[*] Fixed the "Race Results" button sometimes being disabled in the Rivals post-race menu. [1885834]  
[*] Fixed an issue where the incorrect group name would appear in the Podium UI. [1906361]  
[*] Players readying for Spectate will now show a checkmark instead of the spectating icon in the pre-race lobby. [1880154]  
[*] Fixed an issue where the Driver List entries were not correctly updating with the creator's Tune and/or Design details. [1805337]  
[*] Fixed an issue where the download spinner would not dismiss for replay file thumbnails. [1883714]  
[*] Fixed an issue with navigating the driver list during Spectate and Replays. [1877283] 
[/list]
[h2]Drivatar AI [All Platforms] [/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where AI drivers were unaffected by a wet track during events with variable weather conditions. [1750188] 
[*] Updated AI to reduce erratic/unrealistic braking behaviors around players. [1899880] 
[/list]
[h2]Forza Race Regulations [All Platforms] [/h2]
[list]
[*] Pushed a new Forza Race Regulations (FRR) model with a slight reduction to false positive penalty assignments.  
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could be disqualified by going off track prior to crossing the Start/Finish line. [1877124] 
[*] FRR will now take tire wear into account when computing time gained for off-track penalties. [1907347] 
[/list]
[h2]Cars [All Platforms] [/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the 2023 McLaren Artura did not have a price when viewing or selling the car from the player’s garage. [1909274] 
[/list]

notes.title: Bathurst Returns for Australia Month in Forza Motorsport
notes.content:
Car passion is deeply rooted in Australia. Celebrate its racing heritage over the next four weeks with Australia Month in Forza Motorsport. 

Over in Career, the Australia Tour is where you will experience the storied legacy of Australian motoring culture: from the iconic Mount Panorama Circuit, where the legendary Bathurst 1000 endurance race unfolds amidst breathtaking scenery, to the Australian-made sport utes that seamlessly blend speed and utility.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/a7e68ec7420166185b9bdadc11e2b0d49d190c16.png[/img]

Compete in high-performance V8-powered supercars in the Forza AUS Series in Featured Multiplayer, featuring Bathurst exclusively for the duration of Australia Month. Rolling Starts expand to additional Spec Series, while the Nordschleife and Nürburgring – Full Circuit have been added to select Open Series events.   

Update 15 also introduces the ability to upgrade cars in Featured Multiplayer Open Events, faster transitions in Spectate and Replay, changes to Safety Ratings, and Ray-Traced Global Illumination (RTGI) for players on high-end PCs. 

[h2]Game Improvements and Release Notes [/h2]

Forza Motorsport Update 15 rolls out for download starting Monday, December 9 on Xbox Series X|S and PC via the Microsoft Store and Steam. Spotlight cars and new in-game events will begin on Wednesday, December 11 starting at 4:00 PM PT (12:00 AM UTC on Thursday, December 12). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/57e01f6b53a29db83f9f062634b15bff86f21283.png[/img]

Below is a snapshot of the fixes and improvements included with Update 15. [url=http://aka.ms/FMUpdate15RN]Head on over to Forza Support to view the full release notes[/url]:   

[list]
[*] Transitional black loading screens when switching camera types and cars on focus in both Spectate and Replay have been replaced by quick fades wherever possible, closer to the blink of an eye. Loading screens will only appear when changing streaming zones, such as jumping from one end of a long track to another. For PC players, this experience may vary based on system specs. 
[*] We have adjusted the impact of recent races on your Safety Rating to reduce severe rating fluctuations and to more accurately reflect your overall race history.  
[*] We have also increased the number of races used to calculate your Safety Rating. Previously, we increased the number of races from 10 to 20 and saw positive results. In this update, this number is further increasing from 20 to 50. 
[*] Updated Forza GT Division cars in Showroom to reflect their Divisions in Featured Multiplayer (Forza GT2, Forza GT3, Forza GT4, Forza AUS, and Forza T/A). 
[*] Fixed an issue where AI drivers were unaffected by a wet track during events with variable weather conditions. 
[*] Updated Drivatar AI to reduce erratic/unrealistic braking behaviors around players.  
[/list]

Update 15 introduces a new model for Forza Race Regulations (FRR). This version brings a slight reduction to false positive penalty assignments, takes tire wear into account when computing time gained for off-track penalties, and fixes an issue where the player could be disqualified by going off track prior to crossing the Start/Finish line. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/324123c2132aa2976f1ffa63024764e1a2bbc711.png[/img]

Today’s update also includes enhanced car audio for the following vehicles: 

[list]
[*] 1991 BMW M3 
[*] 1994 Ferrari F355 Berlinetta 
[*] 2013 Ferrari La Ferrari 
[*] 2015 Ferrari F12 TDF 
[*] 2017 Ferrari 812 Superfast 
[*] 2015 McLaren P1 GTR 
[/list]

For additional information on how we’re updating the car sounds of Forza Motorsport, [url=https://forza.net/news/in-the-garage-audio-discord-ama]check out this blog[/url], adapted from a presentation and AMA (“ask me anything”) hosted in the [url=https://discord.gg/forza]Forza Official Discord[/url] with the Turn 10 audio team.  

[h2]Ray-Traced Global Illumination (RTGI) on PC [/h2]

A new graphics option for our PC players has been added to Forza Motorsport's ray tracing settings to enable Ray Traced Global Illumination in the game, or RTGI for short. Players with high-end PCs can enable this new option to improve overall visual quality. 

RTGI uses ray tracing hardware to compute more accurate indirect lighting and occlusion across the track and car in real time. This results in enhanced visual fidelity and realism in the game.  

RTGI is a new setting that must be enabled and is not on by default. Turn on RTGI and scale its rendering quality in the Forza Motorsport Graphics menu using the following toggles: 

[b]RTGI OFF[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/cd66cabca16f31d5eaa47d735beac7797a9f4e66.png[/img]
[b]RTGI ON[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/afd3335167e9cd239dbb40647884d05d60c021f1.png[/img]
[b]RTGI OFF[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/220c468091ae43020626232ba36281613453d0a3.png[/img]
[b]RTGI ON[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/9bd2be887a84815ef596d67461ec1b4ec04a39b5.png[/img]
[b]RTGI OFF[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/f2dd011983d868ee503efc236c83eb89c04b876a.png[/img]
[b]RTGI ON[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/55c09d1d45c968d806b3056b5649ec51ec9beec2.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Set Raytracing Quality to "Full Reflections + RTGI"   
[*] Set RTGI Quality to "High" 
[/list]

When enabled, RTGI will apply to all gameplay and cinematics, as well as your Homespace and Photo Mode. If you require assistance with using RTGI on your PC, please see this Support article. 
[h2]
Car Upgrades in Featured Multiplayer [/h2]

Custom Upgrade and Quick Upgrade functionality are now accessible from within Featured Multiplayer events for Series that allow it, including all Open Class Series, Cycled Class Series, and the Multi-Class Series.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/48ae59ac8fc92cb2ff37b4d1451b47204068fc1a.png[/img]
[i]Captured on PC with RTGI[/i]

This makes it easier than ever to tweak your current build without needing to leave the event or experiment with a new setup before the race starts. Additionally, this improves visibility for any PI Limits that may be in place for the current event.  

[h2]Race on Mount Panorama Circuit [/h2]

Bathurst is renowned for its competitive racing scene in the land down under. The 3.8-mile (6.2km) circuit sees drivers battle it out across Mount Panorama in New South Wales, Australia. Made up entirely of public roads, Bathurst is essentially a street circuit with a 570-foot (174-meter) elevation change, off-camber corners, and narrow racing surface.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/78ef47c3ebb8c91520e8b184a734fc2b1b1db89e.png[/img]

With spectacular views ahead of each technical twist and turn, Bathurst has hosted V8 Supercars for over 80 years – with the exhilarating Conrod Straight allowing them to reach speeds of almost 200mph! As one of the most demanding yet rewarding racetracks in the entire world, the Mount Panorama Circuit is both feared and respected, especially by the drivers who have raced there.  

Master this world-famous track while behind the wheel of beloved Aussie cars in the Australian Tour, Forza AUS Series, and Featured Rivals.    

[h2]Discover Aussie Classics in the Australian Tour [/h2]

Australian racing culture embodies a passion for ingenuity, speed, and adventure. Race in the Australian Tour with V8 Supercars, Australian Saloons, Aussie Classics and Sport Utes.  

[b]V8 Supercars [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/258e6feb2d9ef6869f21e71d24c63d8229308edf.png[/img]

Choose between the 2017 Ford #17 Shell V-Power Racing Team Falcon FG X and 2017 Holden #22 Walkinshaw Performance VF Commodore and compete with V8s from around the world. 

[b]Australian Saloons [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/549702ec4343830ebba61fd01fcc1050bf29d5a2.png[/img]

The 1991 Holden HSV Commodore Group A SV showcased the early 1990s era of low-cost amateur sedan racing, dominated by large Australian saloons. Pick your favorite Holden and race it against 1990s Touring cars of the same class. 

[b]Aussie Classics [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/5d8a3fcec0dbcf7533a43add2d0315334b883916.png[/img]

Leaving their mark in pop culture, famous Aussie cars like the 1973 Ford XB Falcon GT have made their name on the big screen in blockbuster movies. Demonstrate the raw power of Australian muscle in the penultimate series of the Australian Tour.    

[b]Super Utes [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/b1b6d6b85e6561e20fb0338843d3a6112bb7a26b.png[/img]

Race Australian Utes and discover one of the most unique car hybrids in the world. Built on utility and unique looks before being adopted into motorsports, race the 2014 HSV Limited Edition GEN-F GTS Maloo or 2014 Ford FPV Limited Edition Pursuit Ute against their 2010s competitors. 

[b]Australian Tour Reward [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/50a62f8b6a8e9fa48b5baef190bacfde05694214.png[/img]

Complete all four series in the Australian Tour in Career before January 22, 2025, or 10 races in the Forza AUS Series in Featured Multiplayer during Australia Month, to earn the 2013 Holden #10 Xbox Racing Team Commodore VF. 

The Xbox One Racing Team was formed as a wildcard, one-off entry to celebrate the Bathurst track in Forza Motorsport 5. Andy Priaulx and Mattias Ekström drove the #10 to an astounding ninth place in the 2013 Bathurst 1000 race. The fact that the car – and its drivers – surprised everyone with their performance added to the spectacle of what is one of the world’s most difficult endurance races. 

[h2]Cherish Your Aussie Favs in the Open Tour [/h2]

Once you have mastered racing the Mount Panorama Circuit, Bathurst in Forza Motorsport, check out the Open Class Tour to continue the journey of your favorite Australian cars. Available under the Featured tab in Career mode.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/64436b6f4e298d40245e9b1d76738d274da67fd3.png[/img]

Open Class Tour is where you can experiment with different upgrades and showcase your favorite tuned cars. Each update to Forza Motorsport refreshes the Open Class Tour with new events and a different reward car. Cars you’ve already upgraded in a different Builders Cup series can be further levelled up in the Open Class Tour.   

The Open Class Tour features six series, each with three races, that range from D Class to R Class. Upgrade your favorite Australian saloons – or any other cars of your choosing – and use them to complete all six series in the Open Class Tour before January 8, 2025, and you will receive the 2011 Holden HSV GTS. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/40e789499ffa9362c3eab87161d1293905a7bd31.png[/img]

You can also unlock the 2011 Holden HSV GTS by completing 10 races in any Open Series in Featured Multiplayer. With a 6.2-liter V8 capable of 436 horsepower and a remarkable engine note, this Holden has the muscle for straight-line speed. It also features a dramatic front end complete with a unique vase-shaped grille.

[tr][td]Weekly Safety Challenge [/td][td]Complete 5 races without receiving a penalty in Featured Multiplayer [/td][td]25,000 Credits [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Weekly Rivals Challenge [/td][td]Complete 10 laps in Rivals in an Australian car [/td][td]10,000 Credits [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Weekly Track Challenge [/td][td]Complete 5 clean laps at Bathurst [/td][td]25,000 Credits [/td][/tr]
[/table]
[h2]Race Down Under in Bathurst [/h2]

That’s Australia Month in Forza Motorsport. We hope you enjoy racing Australian cars around Mount Panorama Circuit in the Australian Tour and Forza AUS Series in Featured Multiplayer. 

[url=https://aka.ms/SHUB]Please continue sharing your ideas for new cars, tracks and features with us over on the Suggestions Hub, and they might be considered for inclusion in future updates.[/url] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/957bbabef5c69b7c12366830a0d2fc806873fd35.png[/img]

If you encounter any issues while playing Forza Motorsport or enjoying Update 15 features, [url=https://aka.ms/THUB]they can be reported on the Troubleshooting Hub[/url]. Please be sure to include any reproduction steps to help our team investigate, and if another player has reported a similar problem, you can upvote their topic to help bring additional visibility to it. 

Update 15 is our last content update for 2024, however we have more coming to Forza Motorsport in 2025, including additional cars, tracks, and new community requested features. Update 16 will be available in January as a celebration of all things BMW with new cars and events. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/9a6dad23fdd87577bac0a76b86af2ba3a8ccc5ee.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more details about Update 16 in next month’s blog! In the meantime, [url=https://forza.net/newsletter]sign up for the Forza Newsletter to be in the loop with all things Forza[/url]. You can also join our [url=https://discord.gg/forza]official Forza Discord server[/url] to chat with other Forza Motorsport players, participate in community events and future “In the Garage” AMAs, and be informed of the latest in-game updates. 

Until the next one, we hope you all enjoy the holidays and get some well-earned rest, and we look forward to racing with you on the track!

notes.title: Update 14 Bug Fixes and Changes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/030292ffe954c1057f4e2dec3a56ece2eafe26fd.jpg[/img]
[h1]Bug Fixes and Improvements [/h1]

[h2]Stability and Performance [All Platforms] [/h2]
•	Fixed an issue where the game will sometimes crash when attempting to reset Free Play Setup settings to default after changing the Game Type to Multi-Class. [1869841] 
•	Improving loading time for vinyl groups on "My Vinyl Group" screen. [1745045] 
•	Improved performance when navigating between Vinyl Groups and Liveries menu. [1881236] 
•	Fixed an uncommon crash that could happen when loading liveries for AI Drivatars in Free Play events. [1720394] 
•	Fixed a possible game crash when pressing Confirm on Quick Upgrade. [1871855] 
•	Fixed an issue where the game could crash when accepting challenges. [1882995] 

[h2]Rendering [All Platforms] [/h2]
•	The global reflection probe for the track is now captured at the camera location and includes the track itself. This allows reflections to appear more accurate and prevents visual pops in the reflections by smoothly fading over time. 

[h2]Audio [All Platforms] [/h2]
•	Updated car audio for the following vehicles based on community feedback: 
•	2010 Lamborghini Murciélago LP 670-4 SV 
•	2019 Lamborghini Sian FKP 37 
•	2013 McLaren P1 
We recently shared details about how we updated our authoring techniques and pipelines so that we can fix as many car audio issues as possible. [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-audio-updates]Please read this blog for additional details regarding our approach to future car audio updates in Forza Motorsport[/url]. 

[h2]PC [/h2]
•	Fixed an issue that would cause the hint text "Camera" to appear during Photo Mode, while using mouse and keyboards controls. [1873842] 
•	Alt-tabbing out and back into the game while in the Driving Assists menu will no longer remove controller selection focus. [1855918] 

[h2]Gameplay [All Platforms] [/h2]
•	Fixed an issue where a car's upgrades would also be reset if the player reset its tuning. [1793493] 
•	Performance rating is now correctly synced with the server even if the player leaves the upgrade screen immediately after equipping the previous part back. [1834457] 
•	Players are now able to move AI Drivatars from one group to another and resort the grid. [1849430] 

[h2]Career [All Platforms] [/h2]
•	Fixed an issue where certain cars would be ghosted in the First Cup race. [1878447] 
•	Fixed an issue where the player would become soft locked if they drove into the pit lane during the First Cup on Hakone. [1883718] 

[h2]Featured Multiplayer [All Platforms] [/h2]
•	Fixed an issue where players with a warning or ban history could get their current session into a banned state by going into Photo Mode. [1865162]  
•	Fixed an issue where upcoming series were sorted above active series in the Featured Multiplayer Event Select UI. [1811224] 
•	Medium races in Featured Multiplayer events have been updated to target a 20-minute race length. 

[h2]Spec Series Car Division Changes [All Platforms] [/h2]
[table]
[tr][th][b]Car [/b][/th][th][b]Change Summary [/b][/th][/tr]
[tr][td]1988 Chevrolet #77 Beretta Trans Am [/td][td]Added to and balanced within the GTX Sportscar Series [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]2010 Mazda #16 Mazda Racing B09/86 [/td][td]Added to and balanced within the Forza P2 Series [/td][/tr]
[/table]
[h2]Private Multiplayer [All Platforms] [/h2]
•	Fixed an issue where the mini leaderboard wasn't sorting players correctly in Drift events. [1874885, 1874059] 
•	Fixed an issue where wet tires sometimes weren't automatically applied in rainy weather events. [1889744] 
•	Fixed an issue where players could be disconnected for inactivity in post-race in Private Multiplayer events. [1873846] 
•	Fixed a bug which incorrectly calculated Drift Lap Score when spectating. [1835503] 
•	Fixed an issue where the car's fuel level would not be correctly adjusted during Practice in Private Multiplayer. [1846275] 
•	Non-host players now have a UI element to convey information on whether the player's ready to race, ready to spectate, or unready. [1874596] 
•	Fixed bug where selecting Spectate would not automatically register that player as ready on the Host's game. [1874761] 
•	Fixed an issue where the Rivals Post Race menu would not be properly displayed, and the user would encounter a black screen. [1845974] 
•	Fixed a lobby disconnect which occurred when ending a Meetup with Drift scoring options on Sunset Peninsula. [1887663] 
•	Fixed an issue where accepting a Private Multiplayer invite while the livery save popup is displayed would cause game instability. [1880246] 
•	Fixed a crash which occurred when the player being spectated, or the host, quits the race. [1884897] 
•	Fixed an issue where the player would be locked in a loading screen while joining a Private Multiplayer lobby. [1873777] 

[h2]Livery Editor & UGC [All Platforms] [/h2]
•	Autosaved tunes no longer apply to a player's tune save limit. [1846128] 
•	[b]Developers Note:[/b] Autosaved tunes still appear in the game menus, however they do not impact your tune save limit, which is currently 450 tunes. We are actively working on increasing save limits for a future release. 
•	Fixed an issue where livery changes would not be saved. [1885895]  
•	Fixed an issue where existing UGC could not be overwritten in Save Livery, Tuning, or Photo menus. [1887664]  
•	Fixed an issue where the VIP Driver Suit choice might be reset when restarting the game. [1739411]  
•	Fixed an issue in the Photo and Replay Gallery which caused the Search Results tab to appear twice after doing a search. [1825605]  
•	Fixed an issue where the player's rims would incorrectly revert back to their default color when dismissing the color changing prompt. [1814663]  
•	Fixed an issue where cars placed in the Showcase Bay would show the incorrect livery. [1877349]  
•	Fixed an issue where the loading UI element would not disappear when an item has finished downloading. [1880229]  

[h2]UI [All Platforms] [/h2]
•	Added a ‘Sort by Overall’ / ‘Sort by Group’ button to Event Results for Multi-Class Races allowing players to compare how they did against the overall driver list. [1797481] 
•	Fixed an issue where backing out of the Car Select Menu from an Open Class Tour will carry the same restrictions over to the Car Select Menus outside of the event. [1873066] 
•	Fixed an issue where the player loses HUD information when attempting to resume the game with a controller connected on PC, while focused on a second monitor. [1648491]  
•	Fixed a crash that occurred on PC when the file popup module for My Files is shown in a Community tab and the Share option is selected. Also, fixed the file options modal not opening in game options and while saving a UGC item. [1871675] 
•	Fixed an issue where the Start Race button was enabled too early after ending a Meetup, which could lead to unexpected behavior in pre-race scenarios. [1889096] 
•	Fixed an issue that resulted in an endless progress spinner on the info panel while attempting to save a tuning setup in the Upgrade & Tune menu. [1859128] 
•	Fixed an issue where a red gradient would appear over thumbnails while loading. [1883663] 
•	Fixed an issue where a random player-owned car would show up in the player's Primary Car Bay. [1856582] 
•	Fixed an issue where the “Wet Tires Applied” notification was either not displaying when it should or was displaying when it should not. [1870270] [1812557] 
•	Fixed an issue where Best Drift value was not being calculated correctly when fast forwarding or rewinding a Drift Replay. [1877123] 

[h2]Drivatar AI [All Platforms] [/h2]
•	Fixed a bug where tire wear was not correctly affecting grip of Drivatar AI opponents in races. [1820786] 
•	Improved Drivatar AI pitting logic, especially in Endurance Races. [1820786, 1884711]  

[h2]Physics [All Platforms] [/h2]
•	Fixed an issue on Mugello and other tracks where hitting curbs could cause sporadic, uncontrollable spins. This would occasionally occur when one or more tires rapidly accelerated or decelerated while unloaded during cornering. While curbs can naturally affect car balance, this fix ensures more predictable handling in these scenarios. As in real life, drivers should still approach curbs with caution, as they can disrupt vehicle stability.  
•	Adjusted track wall friction on Eaglerock Speedway, Daytona, Homestead, and Indianapolis to more accurately reflect physical material properties. [1888599, 1890395]  

[h2]Accessibility [All Platforms] [/h2]
•	Fixed an issue where the Drift UI would not meet high contrast mode standards. [1875857]  
•	Adjusted the drift HUD to improve contrast ratio. [1870244]  
•	Added screen narration to the event countdown timer displayed when UI overlaps occur with the regular timer. [1873944]

notes.title: 2024 NASCAR Season Heats Up in Forza Motorsport
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/a0d5810b5c4651eb2af361222f98b8b8ccfa9c64.png[/img]

Forza Motorsport Update 14 invites you to step behind the wheel of next-generation NASCAR stock racers. The American Thunder Tour is where you will experience the advanced 2024 Next Gen NASCAR racers. From Homestead-Miami and Indianapolis to Eaglerock Speedway and Sunset Peninsula, this month is a competitive celebration of oval stock car racing in Forza Motorsport.   

Visit the Showroom to acquire three all-new NASCAR racers – the 2024 Chevrolet NASCAR Next Gen Camaro ZL1, 2024 Ford NASCAR Next Gen Mustang Dark Horse and 2024 Toyota NASCAR Next Gen Camry XSE – available as Spotlight cars during Week 1 of American Thunder.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/56443d35953d5053a2311e75edc6ca657dffe2dc.png[/img]

This update also tunes the competitiveness of Drivatar AI for more intense oval racing, and adds rolling starts to multiplayer races – an essential element of the new NASCAR Series in Featured Multiplayer, available to race over the next 5 weeks. While a limited-time event for American Thunder Month, it will also return in the future as part of our Featured Multiplayer Series rotations. 

[h2]Game Improvements and Release Notes[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/4a1d421837d3b9249ffceb96f378490a3cea1cb3.png[/img]

Below is a snapshot of the fixes and improvements included with Update 14. [url=http://aka.ms/FMUpdate14RN]Head on over to Forza Support to view the full release notes[/url]:
[list]
[*] The global reflection probe for the track is now captured at the camera location and includes the track itself. This allows reflections to appear more accurate and prevents visual pops in the reflections by smoothly fading over time. 
[*] Fixed an issue on Mugello and other tracks where hitting curbs could cause sporadic, uncontrollable spins. This would occasionally occur when one or more tires rapidly accelerated or decelerated while unloaded during cornering. While curbs can naturally affect car balance, this fix ensures more predictable handling in these scenarios. As in real life, drivers should still approach curbs with caution, as they can disrupt vehicle stability. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the game will sometimes crash when attempting to reset Free Play Setup settings to default after changing the Game Type to Multi-Class. 
[*] Improved performance when navigating between Vinyl Groups and Liveries menu.  
[*] Fixed an issue where a car's upgrades would also be reset if the player reset its tuning. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the mini leaderboard wasn't sorting players correctly in Drift events. 
[*] Fixed an issue where existing UGC could not be overwritten in Save Livery, Tuning, or Photo menus. 
[*] Added a ‘Sort by Overall’ / ‘Sort by Group’ button to Event Results for Multi-Class Races allowing players to compare how they did against the overall driver list. 
[*] Fixed a bug where tire wear was not correctly affecting grip of Drivatar AI opponents in races. 
[*] Improved Drivatar AI pitting logic, especially in Endurance Races. 
[*] Adjusted track wall friction on Eaglerock Speedway, Daytona, Homestead, and Indianapolis to more accurately reflect physical material properties. 
[*] Autosaved tunes no longer apply to a player's tune save limit. 
[/list]

[b]Developers Note:[/b] Autosaved tunes still appear in the game menus, however they do not impact your tune save limit, which is currently 450 tunes. We are actively working on increasing save limits for a future release. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/7f7bec4235b705eeb77be2034a55097e8695efe2.png[/img]

Today’s update also includes enhanced car audio for the following vehicles:  
[list]
[*] 2010 Lamborghini Murciélago LP 670-4 SV  
[*] 2019 Lamborghini Sian FKP 37  
[*] 2013 McLaren P1  
[/list]
We recently shared details about how we updated our authoring techniques and pipelines so that we can fix as many car audio issues in the game as possible. [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-audio-updates]Please read this blog for additional details regarding our approach to future car audio updates in Forza Motorsport.[/url]

[h2]NASCAR Gameplay Adjustments [/h2]
November is NASCAR month! To celebrate, we’ve made global changes in both Updates 13 and 14 to improve the racing experience across the game, and to make oval racing especially shine: 
[list]
[*] Tuned Drivatar AI on Ovals to have cleaner race starts, transition more smoothly after race start, and to trail more effectively.   
[*] Tuned car-to-car collision response for more physically accurate energy dissipation. This reduces the impact of small collisions and allows for more stability and control. 
[*] Improved Drivatar AI trailing ability especially in braking zones, making Drivatars less prone to rear ending other cars. (Update 13)  
[*] Downforce reduction for lead cars when drafting was reduced to make it easier to maintain position. (Update 13) 
[*] Updated the multi-car aero model to reduce downforce impact on leading cars, widen the aero wake near the car, smooth transitions near wake edges and reduce drafting induced aero balance changes. (Update 13) 
[*] Additionally, we’ve added support for rolling starts in Featured Multiplayer. Rolling starts will be enabled for all events in the NASCAR Series in Featured Multiplayer in Update 14. Rolling starts will be added to additional events, where appropriate, starting in Update 15.   
[/list]
Homestead-Miami Speedway track layouts have also been refreshed with new NASCAR branding – check it out and be sure to snap some photos or replays of your favorite battles on the track! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/10c9a0af0d6c97cec12a48387f72a30dbff096f0.png[/img]

In addition, with Update 14, we’ve pushed a new Forza Race Regulations model with a slight reduction to false positive penalty assignments, and an improvement to severity assignment.   

[h2]Advanced Ghosting in Multiplayer [/h2]
Advanced Ghosting is a support mechanism for Multiplayer and Forza Race Regulations to help prevent some key collision or off-track situations from adversely affecting the online racing experience. Players will be ghosted in the following scenarios: 
[list]
[*] [b]Predicted high relative velocity collisions:[/b] when an imminent collision between two cars is detected while driving above the speed threshold, the car with the higher velocity will be ghosted. This does not include low-relative velocity collisions like small fender bumps. 
[*] [b]Returning to track:[/b] when a car goes off track, they will be ghosted to prevent collisions caused by unsafe re-entry until they have returned to track and reached a minimum speed threshold. 
[*] [b]Stopped on track or driving below a speed threshold:[/b] cars that are driving too slowly or are entirely stopped and blocking traffic will be ghosted to prevent risk to other cars. 
[*] [b]Driving the wrong way on track:[/b] cars driving the wrong direction on track will be ghosted until driving the correct amount of time and meeting a specific speed threshold. This is an existing behavior but has been expanded to include cars at extreme angles relative to track direction and speed.  
[/list]
Experientially, our goal was to use this system to safeguard against egregious collision and griefing behavior, while preserving the physical authenticity of racing where bumping and touching may occur when fighting for position. 

[h2]Roaring Racers in the American Thunder Tour [/h2]
American motorsport is unique in the global racing landscape. From roaring stock cars thundering around oval tracks like Indianapolis and Daytona to the precision and agility showcased in road racing on Sebring, the spectacle is undeniable. 

[h3]Modern NASCAR [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/1b8f4df1ba6e41281ca6e1fe078dbf0e46624ef5.png[/img]
The American Thunder Tour starts with a celebration of Modern NASCAR as three new 2024 Next Gen NASCAR racers duke it out on oval tracks vying for dominance. Choose your favorite of the three to compete with in this NASCAR-focused series. 

[h3]American Road Racing[/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/648560462f3e22097e70c04107c17e99602a35c4.png[/img]
American cars in the 1970s through 1980s represented the power, thunder and muscle of racing. Take a tour through tracks in the Americas while competing against this era of cars in American Road Racing. 

[h3]American Le Mans[/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/e90b8660989407812209dac7cd50584fd9e7b37a.png[/img]
Tracks in the United States like Road Atlanta are home to Le Mans events outside of Europe such as Petit Le Mans. Experience the competition of cars from 2010s to modern era in American Le Mans. For the Spotlight cars, it's Chevy vs Mazda, as two iconic 2010s era endurance cars go head-to-head in endurance races featuring American tracks. 

[h3]Daytona Prototypes [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/0a724d217acfaed8e783e4a4f688bb733263ccc1.png[/img]
Race to the limit in Daytona Prototypes, the final series in the American Thunder Tour. Compete on tracks that highlight the technical excellence and robustness of Daytona Prototypes. 

[h3]American Thunder Tour Reward [/h3]
Complete all four series in the American Thunder Tour in Career before December 25, 2024, or 10 NASCAR Series races in Featured Multiplayer during American Thunder Month, to earn the new-to-Motorsport 1988 Chevrolet #77 Beretta Trans Am.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/07fc383acb180740887f92fc0bf6051e75c545bf.png[/img]

Powered by a fuel injected 3.0-liter V6 engine, the 1988 Chevrolet #77 Beretta Trans Am was built to compete in the legendary Trans Am Series. It is made with a fiber-glass body put on top of a carbon tub. Race the #77 Beretta Trans Am on Mid-Ohio Sports Car Course in the Reward Showcase. 

[h2]Stock Car Racing in the Open Tour [/h2]

Once you have mastered racing the world-famous tracks across the massive breadth of the USA in the American Thunder Tour, check out the Open Class Tour to continue the story of these iconic racecars. Check it out under the Featured tab in Career mode.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/4880655f5718b66b66a480ce1e556e9ce708e457.png[/img]

Open Class Tour is where you can resume the journey of your favorite tuned cars, and each update to Forza Motorsport refreshes the Open Class Tour with new events and a different reward car. Cars you’ve already upgraded in a different Builders Cup series can be further levelled up in the Open Class Tour.   

The Open Class Tour features six series, each with three races, that range from D Class to R Class. Upgrade your favorite stock racers – or any other cars of your choosing – and use them to complete all six series in the Open Class Tour before December 11, 2024, and you will receive the 2019 Hennessey Camaro Exorcist, new-to-Motorsport with Update 14.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/a58cd47f8e0f6b8c5409aa062a46d1e926407d37.png[/img]

You can also unlock the 2019 Hennessey Camaro Exorcist by completing 10 Cycled Class Series races in Featured Multiplayer.  

The fastest Camaro ever created has arrived in Forza Motorsport and it comes equipped with a 6.2-liter supercharged V8 engine that powers this car with 1,000 bhp. As one of the most powerful road cars in the world, its 0-60 mph time is an awe-inspiring 2.1 seconds; meaning the Hennessey Camaro Exorcist can finish a quarter mile in just 9.57 seconds. 

[h2]Spotlight Cars and VIP Discounts [/h2]
Spotlight cars are featured in the Showroom every week. These cars correspond to the available in-game events and can be acquired with a temporary 30% discount using in-game credits.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/25385fb532efa50fa7e42b5903de7d584886aa93.png[/img]

American Thunder Month introduces some new-to-Motorsport Spotlight cars to the Showroom: the three 2024 Next Gen NASCAR vehicles, as well as the 2010 Mazda #16 Mazda Racing B09/86. 

In total, American Thunder will showcase nine Spotlight cars in the Showroom, with one or more cars per week. These Spotlight cars can be used in the American Thunder Tour and Spotlight Rivals, as well as to complete Challenge Hub objectives.

In addition, VIPs receive an exclusive 15% discount on a car every week in the Showroom. In Update 14, these cars will be classic and modern American racers which can be entered into the Featured and Spec Series events in Featured Multiplayer available throughout American Thunder Month. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/66e6a124003392f01823a93db86e8c220d63fa66.png[/img]

That’s American Thunder Month in Forza Motorsport! We hope you enjoy the new NASCAR vehicles and the classic American racecars being showcased over the next five weeks. [url=https://aka.ms/SHUB]Please continue sharing your ideas for new cars, tracks and features with us over on the Suggestions Hub, and they might be considered for inclusion in future updates.[/url] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/f7c00a0d7d43deb3b5d3b2644b35311056e7c135.png[/img]

Update 15 will be available in December as our last release before the start of the New Year. This next update is called Australia Month, featuring the return of Mount Panorama Circuit – home of the legendary Bathurst 1000 endurance race – and will celebrate the diverse racing heritage of cars from the land down under.  

Look forward to additional details about Update 15 in next month’s blog. Until then, have fun with NASCAR across our lineup of American Thunder events, and we’ll see you on the grid in Featured Multiplayer!

notes.title: Enhancing the Car Sounds of Forza Motorsport
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I’m Nick Wiswell, Audio Director at Turn 10 Studios, and today I want to give you all some details on the audio changes you will hear in Forza Motorsport with the release of Update 13, Mustang Month, and our plans for future updates.

With this blog, I will personally address some of the feedback you have been sending us since we released the game last October. We hear you, and the plans that we are sharing today are in direct response to this – thank you for sharing your honest thoughts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/c2e6576c6a0c8ead5c36231267855edda85bcb44.png[/img]

First, I’d like to give you some insights into the team we have assembled, and some important changes we have made to deliver the best audio experience possible when racing.

I’ve been at Turn 10 Studios since 2010, and I worked directly as Audio Director on Forza Motorsport 4 through Forza Motorsport 6. After that I moved into publishing focused roles working on Forza Horizon and Forza Street, and then into a more technical role before returning to Forza Motorsport full time in March 2023.

When I rejoined the team last year, most of the game’s audio content was already complete, so our efforts were focused on refining the assets we already had. After closely listening to your feedback, we have started incorporating new tools and processes into our audio workflow so we can deliver great sounding, authentic content moving forward. To ensure we have the best people we can leading these efforts, Turn 10 Studios rehired one of our former Sound Designers this past spring to help deliver these new plans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/27e8ca0253509d90086d5d7a3d9558eed40127fa.png[/img]

To give you some context, this sound designer worked on Forza Motorsport (2005) through Forza Motorsport 3, as well as both Forza Motorsport 4 and Forza Motorsport 5 from a central Xbox audio team role. He then joined Polyphony Digital to work on GT Sport and Gran Turismo 7. I first met him when I was at Bizarre Creations working on the Project Gotham Racing games – Xbox’s premier racing game before the days of Forza – and I’m excited to work with him again. Between us, we have made a lot of great sounding racing games – and from some of the posts I’ve seen online, some of you would agree with this!

So, with a new audio leadership team, which includes another lead for our technology and development investments, we are set for the future.

To the state of audio in Forza Motorsport: I will admit that from an authenticity perspective, the game is not where we would like it to be. There are many factors that led to this, but we hope we can set things right going forward. Our goal is to fix these audio issues and ensure that all new cars added to the game are built authentically and uniquely. To achieve this, we have been overhauling our authoring techniques and pipelines so that we can update as many of the most egregious car audio issues as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/19a12618207965db53e75d17fdd4d1206446ae7e.png[/img]

The initial work on this is now complete, and from Update 13 onwards, all cars added to Forza Motorsport will be built to this newer specification. In addition, a number of cars that have been flagged as inauthentic, both internally at the studio and by the community, will be updated over time.

The cars we are initially updating are with the release of Update 13 include the following:
[list]
[*] 2022 Pagani Huayra R
[*] 2014 Chevrolet #3 Corvette Racing Corvette C7.R
[*] 2001 Acura Integra Type R
[/list]
We have also made changes to the cockpit audio on the 2010 Lexus LFA, following its update in a previous release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/28da2ccd2e39d37a28c1190552400142fc2ce1f5.jpg[/img]

As we look forward to future updates, we will weigh factors such as community feedback, internal priority, upcoming featured cars in game and the availability of suitable recordings.

I’d also like to add that there is a lot of speculation about how the car audio is made and where it is sourced. It is all created from recordings of real cars, either captured on a track or on a dyno. Our library contains over 750 vehicle recordings, and more are being sourced and added every month. The changes we are making are built around how these recordings are being processed and edited, and the way we assemble the recordings back together at runtime to be controlled by the in-game physics engine.

I’m not going to give too much of our secret sauce away, but it’s based on the combined experience of our audio team and software engineers, and we are very happy with the changes we are making.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/18d55b054b33d887f99a018148f70b72ff289af8.jpg[/img]

We hope you like them too, and as always, we look forward to feedback from the community. Also, [u]I’ll be speaking with you all next month – November 7 at 3pm PT – on the official Forza Discord server[/u] to go into more detail on our audio development workflows as part of the next “In the Garage” AMA. I hope to see you there.

[h3]Nick Wiswell  
Audio Director   
Turn 10 Studios [/h3]

[h2]Physics [All Platforms][/h2]

[h2]Rivals [All Platforms][/h2]
[list] [*]Fixed an issue where Featured Rivals and VIP Rivals events had dynamic rubbering set to 0% by default. It should now be 100% by default. [1865690][/list]
[h2]Featured Multiplayer [All Platforms][/h2]
[list]
[*]Moved the weekly, cycled one-make series from the Spec tab to Featured tab.

[*]Updated Tire Wear Scalar for all Short and Medium length races to 4x, making tire wear consistent across Short, Medium, and Long races in Featured Multiplayer.
[*]Updated Open Series lineup in Featured Multiplayer based on player feedback and concurrency:
[list] [*]Multi-Class Series has been updated to focus solely on ABCS.
[*]Introduced a new ‘Cycled Class Series’, which changes classes daily, cycling through P, D, X, C, and E Classes.

[*]Fixed an issue where, in certain circumstances in a Private Multiplayer match, players would crash after the host starts the race. [1823425, 1848781]

notes.title: Forza Motorsport Multiplayer, Rivals and Challenge Hub Calendar for Update 13
notes.content:
[h2]Ford Mustang Challenge Series in Featured Multiplayer[/h2]
Experience the evolution of an automotive icon by jumping behind the wheel of your favorite Mustang era in a decade-spanning multi-class series. Unmissable Pony showdowns await in the Ford Mustang Challenge Series available in the Featured tab throughout Update 13.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/71fb669865c9e61bd1314a678e19e42e5617e7e5.png[/img]

There is also a new MX-5 Cup Spec Series. Ideal for beginners and veterans alike, the 2017 Mazda MX-5 Cup is built for single-make racing series, which makes it a thrilling contender in this specialized MX-5 Cup event.  

Available under the Open Events tab is a new Cycled Class Series that rotates events daily between P, D, X, C, and E Classes. With the introduction of this series, which will remain available in the game after Mustang Month, players will get to experience a wider range of classes every week. In addition, the dedicated B, A, S, and R Class Series will continue to cycle weekly as before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/456c2fa8a660d120f3f5f9386dea8c24a93c0f46.jpg[/img]

Update 13 also sees the first Community Choice selections as part of the Featured Multiplayer event rotation: GTX Sportscar Series, Forza Proto-H, and GTP/C Series. These events were decided on by player voting on the Forza forums; stay tuned for additional voting opportunities for the Community Choice Series in future updates.

This update also includes some additional changes to Featured Multiplayer. We have moved the weekly, cycled one-make series from the Spec tab to Featured tab, increased the race length of Medium races to target 18 minutes (previously 16 minutes), updated Tire Wear Scalar for all Short and Medium length races to 4x – making tire wear consistent across Short, Medium, and Long races, and we have updated the Multi-Class Series to focus solely on ABCS.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/b37dadd7d92f77411c672484f3a3680d729e16ec.png[/img]

Here’s a look at the Featured Multiplayer calendar of upcoming events for Mustang Month:
[table]
[tr][th][b]Featured Series[/b][/th][th][b]Spec Series[/b][/th][th][b]Open Series[/b][/th][th][b]Starts[/b][/th][th][b]Ends[/b][/th][/tr]
[tr][td][b]Ford Mustang Challenge Series + GTX Sportscar Series + Shelby GT500 Spec Series[/b][/td][td]Endurance Series + Forza GT2 Spec Series + Forza Touring Car Spec Series [/td][td]Multi-Class Series (ABCS) + Cycled Class Series (P,D,X,C,E) + A Class Series[/td][td]Oct. 16 5pm PT / Oct. 17 12am UTC[/td][td]Oct. 23 5pm PT / Oct. 24 12am UTC[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][b]Ford Mustang Challenge Series + Forza Proto-H + MX-5 Cup Spec Series[/b][/td][td]Endurance Series + Forza GT3 Spec Series + Forza Touring Car Spec Series [/td][td]Multi-Class Series (ABCS) + Cycled Class Series (P,D,X,C,E) + S Class Series[/td][td]Oct. 23 5pm PT / Oct. 24 12am UTC[/td][td]Oct. 30 5pm PT / Oct. 31 12am UTC[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][b]Ford Mustang Challenge Series + GTP/C Series + Formula Mazda Spec Series[/b][/td][td]Endurance Series + Forza GT2 Spec Series + Forza Touring Car Spec Series[/td][td]Multi-Class Series (ABCS) + Cycled Class Series (P,D,X,C,E) + R Class Series[/td][td]Oct. 30 5pm PT / Oct. 31 12am UTC[/td][td]Nov. 6 4pm PT / Nov. 7 12am UTC[/td][/tr]
[/table]
Starting with Update 13, there will no longer be a Spotlight Series. This change will help improve concurrency across all other available Featured Multiplayer Series. We will continue to showcase Spotlight cars in Career, Rivals, and the Challenge Hub.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/7d7d348a9618de0e191cf6f27396162fe59ac372.png[/img]

Following the release of Update 12, we made the decision to remove Forza GT4 from active Featured Multiplayer events due to the lack of cars and competitiveness within the series. In its place, the Forza Touring Car Spec Series remains available. In the future, we intend to explore alternatives to bring back Forza GT4 racing into Featured Multiplayer, for example, through a GT Multi-Class variation. We will also revisit the standalone Forza GT4 Series once we have a larger car roster to accommodate this Spec Division.

[h2]Pony Up in Steadfast Rivals Events[/h2]
Shave off every possible millisecond from your lap times in Rivals with new events for Mustang Month. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/c2e6576c6a0c8ead5c36231267855edda85bcb44.png[/img]

Featuring long straights and challenging banked turns, Sunset Peninsula Raceway is great for testing top speeds and mastering high-speed cornering. Just how fast can you complete a lap on the Full Circuit? That’s your challenge in this month’s Featured Rivals, which puts you behind the wheel of the classic 1982 Ford #6 Zakspeed Roush Mustang IMSA GT.

VIP Members can also show off their driving proficiency at Sunset Peninsula – this time on the Club Reverse Circuit – in the 2018 Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 1LE Forza Edition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/c95eb5226e5b39b74d2040c10e10891036df0b48.png[/img]

We also have a spooky new event just in time for Halloween. Take back the night in the 2015 Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat at Maple Valley in appropriately 'spooky' conditions. Successfully pass at least 100 Rivals on the leaderboard to unlock the Los Muertos Driver Suit from the Challenge Hub.

Buckle up for a new Legends vs Leaderboard Rivals event, this time with Mobil 1 Pro Driver Juan Pablo Montoya. Race the 1974 Toyota Celica GT at Maple Valley – Reverse Circuit and set a lap to get 50,000 credits! Head to mobil1gaming.com to see Juan Pablo set the lap and more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/bbe1ea07bc57ad02fc9c65a17d628c42c8468c6c.png[/img]

As always, look out for Spotlight Rivals featuring the weekly Spotlight cars: the 2024 Ford Mustang GT, 1967 Shelby GT 500, 1995 Ford Mustang SVT Cobra R, and 2013 Ford Shelby GT500.

Update 13 is also the first time that Drift Rivals are available for competition. As noted above, while Drift 101, 102, and 103 events will always be available, future updates will also bring their own Drift Rivals – with A Class Drift and Mediterranean Drift available throughout Mustang Month.
