notes.title: Experience Daytona in Forza Motorsport Update 4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/608633cbdccc6db7ee790bcf2a8d10c0d9816c6e.jpg[/img]
Forza Motorsport Update 4 introduces the prestigious Daytona International Speedway – a truly iconic racetrack renowned for its marvels in engineering. Meanwhile, a new Italian Challengers Featured Tour invites you to build four staples of Italy’s automotive heritage! Let’s dive into the details. 

Update 4 will be available to download on Xbox Series X|S, Windows PCs and Steam beginning on Tuesday, January 16. New events across the Career, Featured Multiplayer and Rivals will start on Thursday, January 18. This version is focused on new content and events, and contains only minor fixes compared to our previous updates. Work on game fixes to address top community issues is ongoing – look out for additional improvements in Update 5 and beyond. 

[h2]New Track – Daytona[/h2] 

Daytona International Speedway is a historic, world-famous track with banked, high-speed corners and in Forza Motorsport, it features two distinct layouts. Master the high-velocity 2.5-mile Tri-oval Circuit and the technical, more challenging 3.59-mile Sports Car Circuit.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/c42935c9b537f6768784a19ff9da336539aaa27b.jpg[/img]
Compete on both layouts in Career Mode and Featured Multiplayer, set your fastest lap times in any car class in Time Attack, or enjoy a Daytona race day either solo or with your friends in Free Play and Private Multiplayer. We’ll also have a special Daytona Sports Car Series in Featured Multiplayer to replicate the excitement of the iconic race weekend.  

Daytona International Speedway was built in 1959 by NASCAR founder Bill France Sr., who wanted to create a track that was faster than any other in the world. Since then, it has hosted several races including the annual Daytona 500, as well as IndyCar and IMSA. The track was renovated in 2016 with the installation of 101,500 seats, making it one of the largest stadiums in the United States! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/d5dcbcb12880343555f376245c3bf0e6e5f37c81.jpg[/img]
With the release of Update 4, select existing Builders Cup series will be updated to integrate Daytona, Hockenheim, and Yas Marina. 

[h2]New Career Tour – Italian Challengers [/h2] 

Discover how Italian cars became an unquestionable staple of the automotive industry in Italian Challengers, the new Featured Tour in Career Mode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/91b1f4a6bcdb40ee5ed50ce976e8c7e97dff8313.jpg[/img]
It starts with All-Wheel Driven, where Lancia stands ready to take on its historic adversaries on the track as you race iconic rally machines. Then in Roadster Renaissance, step behind the wheel of the Abarth 124 Spider and battle the iconic Mazda MX-5 to discover the shared origins of these unique siblings. 

Tour the world of luxury sports sedans – a class once dominated by Audi, BMW, and Mercedes-Benz – and experience a fierce contender in Alfa Performance. Conclude this Featured Tour with Italian beauty, craftsmanship, and speed by racing with track-focused, high-performance Ferrari cars in Prancing Power. 

[table]
[tr][th][b]Tour [/b][/th][th][b]Starts [/b][/th][th][b]Spotlight Car [/b][/th][/tr]
[tr][td]All-Wheel Driven [/td][td]January 18, 2024 [/td][td]1992 Lancia Delta HF Integrale EVO [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Roadster Renaissance [/td][td]January 25, 2024 [/td][td]2017 Abarth 124 Spider [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Alfa Performance [/td][td]February 1, 2024 [/td][td]2017 Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Prancing Power [/td][td]February 8, 2024 [/td][td]2007 Ferrari 430 Scuderia [/td][/tr]
[/table]
Italian Challengers series do not have to be completed in a particular week – you have until February 29, 2024, to finish this latest Featured Tour. Spotlight cars are available at a discount for the week during which they are featured. Complete all 4 series to unlock the 2010 Lamborghini Murciélago LP 670-4 SV! 

[h2]New Career Series – Classic Open Class [/h2] 

With each update to Forza Motorsport, the Open Tour gets refreshed with new events and a new reward car.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/72a6d8c3c96a6f317d4e86f22efa6da8dc7b33fe.jpg[/img]
Open Tour is where you can continue the journey of your favorite cars. Cars that you’ve already built in a different Builders Cup series can be further levelled up and upgraded in the Open Tour.   

In Update 4, the Open Tour is all about racing the classics. Build your favorite cars and bring them to the track to race models of automotive history. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/5be357f81bc001471905ab0bb1b4e2a59563ac3a.jpg[/img]
All 4 refreshed Open Tour series (C, B, A, S) will be available on January 18. Complete all 4 series before February 15, 2024, to add the 1965 Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint GTA Stradale to your collection.    

[h2]New Featured Multiplayer Series – Spec and Open Events [/h2] 

Here’s a look at your Featured Multiplayer calendar of upcoming events for Update 4: 

[table]
[tr][th][b]Spec Series [/b][/th][th][b]Open Series [/b][/th][th][b]Spotlight Series [/b][/th][th][b]Availability [/b][/th][/tr]
[tr][td]Forza P1 Series, Formula Mazda Series [/td][td]S Class Series, A Class Series [/td][td]1992 Lancia Delta HF Integrale EVO [/td][td]January 18-24 [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Daytona Sports Car Series, Formula Mazda Series [/td][td]X Class Series, C Class Series [/td][td]2017 Abarth 124 Spider [/td][td]January 25-31 [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]VW Golf GTI Spec Series, Formula Mazda Series [/td][td]R Class Series, E Class Series [/td][td]2017 Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio [/td][td]February 1-7 [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Modern Factory Racecar Series, Formula Mazda Series [/td][td]P Class Series, B Class Series [/td][td]2007 Ferrari 430 Scuderia [/td][td]February 8-15 [/td][/tr]
[/table]
[h3]Formula Mazda Series – January 18 – February 15 [/h3] 

With their smooth power delivery and brilliant handling, open-wheel Mazda formula cars are an ideal entry-level series to develop a driver’s skills for racing’s top classes. 

[h3]Forza P1 Series – January 18-24 [/h3] 

Experience cutting-edge racecars with massive aerodynamic downforce, super-efficient engines and performance-boosting hybrid systems. 

[h3]Daytona Sports Car Series – January 25-31 [/h3] 

Experience the thrill of Daytona race weekend in Forza Motorsport! Every few hours, the car class cycles between Forza GT, Forza P2, and Forza Proto-H with natural time-of-day progression like the real 24-hour race. 

[h3]VW Golf GTI Spec Series – February 1-7 [/h3] 

Get behind the wheel of the car that gave birth to the Hot Hatch revolution more than four decades ago.   

[h3]Modern Factory Racecar Series – February 8-15 [/h3] 

Race through a field of ultimate track day specials in the Modern Factory Racecar series. These mid-engine production cars feature unique upgrades designed to achieve the highest performance metrics and ensure victory on the track. 

[h2]Featured Rivals – Update 4 [/h2] 

Set your fastest lap times across new Rivals events in Forza Motorsport Update 4. Look out for a special new event featuring the classic 1990 Mercury #15 Whistler Radar Cougar XR-7 at Daytona Tri-oval Circuit. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/e2909cfba4421140d3c09f223fc9e265f2bd3012.jpg[/img]
Meanwhile if you have VIP Membership, check out the Titanic Tuner VIP Rivals on Road America – East Route where you can drive the 2019 Subaru WRX STI S209 Forza Edition. 

Update 3 also means the beginning of Stage 3 of the Logitech McLaren G Challenge. Sign up at Discord.gg/LogitechG to qualify for prizes, including a chance to win a VIP racing experience with McLaren! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/d9525b3fad94643c4ec3df3bd01b5d4b12d2198d.jpg[/img]
Once registered, set your fastest laps at Grand Oak – National Circuit in the 2015 McLaren P1 GTR. The top drivers per region advance to the semifinals in February 2024. 

Here’s the Forza Motorsport Rivals calendar for Update 4: 

[table]
[tr][th][b]Rivals Event [/b][/th][th][b]Car [/b][/th][th][b]Track [/b][/th][th][b]Availability [/b][/th][/tr]
[tr][td]Featured Track – Daytona [/td][td]1990 Mercury #15 Whistler Radar Cougar XR-7 [/td][td]Daytona Tri-oval Circuit [/td][td]January 18 – February 15 [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]*VIP – Titanic Tuner [/td][td]2019 Subaru WRX STI S209 Forza Edition [/td][td]Road America – East Route [/td][td]January 18 – February 15 [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Logitech McLaren G Stage #3 [/td][td]2015 McLaren P1 GTR [/td][td]Grand Oak Raceway – National Circuit [/td][td]January 18 – February 15 [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Spotlight – Lancia [/td][td]1992 Lancia Delta HF Integrale EVO [/td][td]Suzuka Circuit – East [/td][td]January 18-24 [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Spotlight – Abarth [/td][td]2017 Abarth 124 Spider [/td][td]Lime Rock Park – Full Alt [/td][td]January 25-31 [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Spotlight – Alfa Romeo [/td][td]2017 Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio [/td][td]Mid-Ohio Sportscar Course – Short  [/td][td]February 1-7 [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Spotlight – Ferrari [/td][td]2007 Ferrari 430 Scuderia [/td][td]Mugello Circuit – Full [/td][td]February 8-15 [/td][/tr]
[/table]
[i]*VIP Rivals events require VIP Membership, available in the Premium Edition or Premium Add-Ons Bundle, sold separately. [/i]

[h2]See You at Daytona [/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/318ed1742fe1ab70c454e9c37b9b4bcd047daa3c.jpg[/img]
Whether you’re racing Italian Challengers using the new Spotlight cars, competing online at Daytona to celebrate race weekend in the upcoming Featured Multiplayer series, or building your favorite cars in the Open Tour, we can’t wait for you to discover everything Update 4 brings to Forza Motorsport starting on January 16. [url= http://aka.ms/SHUB]Remember you can share your feedback about future cars, tracks and features on our official Forza Suggestions Hub[/url].

notes.title: A Message to the Motorsport Community – January 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/e14d86e29efa991710c618cd30166fb0022fc837.jpg[/img]
We are taking a moment at the start of this year to thank you for your support and feedback since launch, reflect on some of the things we have learned, and share what you can expect from us in the coming months.

In addition to our streams, our update blogs, and the [url=aka.ms/SHUB]Suggestions [/url]and [url=aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting [/url]Hubs, we will commit to publishing quarterly updates like this one to let you know where we stand on items the community is passionate about.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/28da2ccd2e39d37a28c1190552400142fc2ce1f5.jpg[/img]
While we have been heads down adding cars, tracks, patches, and other improvements, we want to acknowledge the top three areas of feedback we haven’t addressed directly first – so here’s what we’ve heard from you.

[h2]Car Progression[/h2]

We know that the progression system in Forza Motorsport is a divisive topic among our players. We’ve been gathering feedback from a variety of sources, including the Suggestions Hub, socials, forums, long-time players, and surveys to players who may not be as active on our traditional community gathering places.

It is clear from looking at feedback that while many of our players are enjoying the system as is, for many others it isn’t delivering the upgrade experience that they expect from Forza Motorsport. To address this, we are exploring changes to the system. Our goal with these changes is to retain what is working for those that enjoy it, while resolving the issues many of our most dedicated players have with the system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/6155bdc6d4fb6f84a3cd8d9190c8818f78f59a2f.jpg[/img]
Addressing this feedback is a top priority for the team going into 2024, however it will take some time to properly evaluate options, make the necessary code changes, and thoroughly test those code changes.

[h2]Forza Race Regulations[/h2]

We are aware that Forza Race Regulations are not working as intended in some situations. We have heard about inconsistent or unfair penalties in instances of intentional ramming, being pushed off the track, and spinning cars pushing drivers off the track. We have also heard that high speed collisions sometimes have no penalties while low speed collisions have mild penalties. It’s important that we capture all the data that we can about a race when FRR rulings happen in error, so over the next few months, we will be working with some long-time competitive Motorsport players to gather direct telemetry from them while they’re playing. They will be capturing these instances and feeding data to our team so that we can issue tweaks to make FRR more accurate and reliable. We appreciate your patience as we work on improving the system.

[h2]AI[/h2]

We have seen feedback about our AI’s driving behavior: abruptly braking and slowing down; not accelerating out of exits, braking too hard on mild corners, and following racing lines too strictly. We understand how important it is to have fair and competitive AI in Motorsport and are our top priorities in early 2024 are addressing overly aggressive AI, while also getting a cleaner race start into turn 1 where many of the issues above most severely manifest and impact players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/50350800c81fcba8336637acc098bf8b0494c3ac.jpg[/img]
The 3 areas mentioned above are just a few examples of what we have seen most often and know you care passionately about. We care about these issues too. These and other issues are constantly being worked on, iterated, and given careful consideration. How and what we implement and when is driven by the desire to improve the experience regularly and consistently in a way that does not sacrifice stability and minimizes any downtime.

Thanks,  
Andy Beaudoin, Forza Motorsport Game Director  
Chris Esaki, Forza Motorsport Creative Director  
Trevor Laupmanis, Forza Motorsport Executive Producer

notes.title: 2023 Forza Year in Review
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/acc1affc14fe844081f99d0822fe8103e630d744.jpg[/img]
Welcome to the 2023 Forza Year in Review! Another 12 months have passed, which means in true Forza tradition, it’s time to look back at everything that’s happened over the last year. We released Forza Motorsport, celebrated the two-year anniversary of Forza Horizon 5, and introduced some of our biggest updates yet with EventLab 2.0 and the Rally Adventure expansion.

We also gave players [url=aka.ms/THUB]a new way to report issues directly to the team with the Troubleshooting Hub[/url] and continue to [url=aka.ms/SHUB]add new cars and features inspired by your input on the Suggestions Hub[/url]. In Forza Horizon 5, we introduced the number one community requested car, the 2010 Nissan Tsuru, and upgraded Photo Mode with time of day and weather settings, as well as placement of the driver character outside the car – [url=https://forza.net/news/community-hubs-update-2]all of which were highly requested suggestions by players[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/b32783c2e6cf28f1d5457e5a808b80a88bb800b6.jpg[/img]
[i]Forza Horizon 5 Photo by CCOCAS. (Share Code 553 567 882)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/e32aafeb182d34cad5f167eb3532aed5fa3d08d7.jpg[/img]
[i]Forza Horizon 5 Photo by Durmell. (Share Code 157 817 253)[/i]

Before we dive into the game recaps, let’s celebrate the creative content you’ve been making over the past year. Every week, the Forza Forums hosts themed Photo and Livery contests open to all players. Thanks to everyone who continues to create and submit their content! To celebrate your creativity, we've handpicked our top 5 favorite community photos and liveries from Forza Horizon 5 over the year. You'll see examples in this blog, and we’ve put them together in our ‘Best of 2023’ collection on the Forza Forums:
[list]
[*][url=https://forums.forza.net/t/best-of-2023-in-fh5-photos/658476]Best of 2023 in FH5 Photos[/url]
[*][url=https://forums.forza.net/t/best-of-2023-in-fh5-liveries/658477]Best of 2023 in FH5 Liveries[/url][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/c1f866cfe3d0bd8ec5e9aa07343144abf39f85ec.jpg[/img]
[i]Forza Horizon 5 "Glitch" livery created by FormFirm. (Share Code: 260 808 658)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/8e0e5248839af431062018dabff60d09a45c89db.jpg[/img]
[i]Forza Horizon 5 "Franken Brides Dually" livery created by Skogarmar. (Share Code: 88 107 114 199)[/i]

[h2]Community Leaders[/h2]

Community event organizers are central to Forza's community, inspiring competition, creativity, and ingenuity. With excitement around Forza Motorsport, 2023 saw organizers using all their expertise to craft events and schedules that could straddle the transition from one game to the next. Kudos to you all!

The year kicked off with the brilliant FTC Renault 5 Cup, seeing both great door to door racing and of course the amazing photography for which FTC have earned renowned across the Forza community. By late February the series was cinched by justScotty--despite close competition from Joeyst25. Look out for FTC in 2024 with Race Academy meets running each and every Sunday.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/a5d80b11a27f98451543c373fc5dcf8d5f483476.png[/img]
[i]Captured by FTC Infernas81: FTC Renault 5 Cup on Forza Motorsport 7.[/i]

March saw Forza Share Your Creations (previously FH5 Livery & Designs) organize a tribute to the late Ken Block. Go Fast Risk Every Thang' attracted paints that were at once touching and astonishing. The top three liveries came from Kgree27, MrMugello, and SnakeEyes Friex but this was a contest where every entrant, from the Mercedes Tankpool24 Racing Truck to the Gymkhana 10 Ford Hoonicorn Mustang, meant the world. You're always in our hearts, Ken.

May was notable as the beginning of the marathon Envy Drift & PTG Street Masters Drift Championship which would see the community's finest skid-artists competing all the way through to August! Alongside congratulating EDM Atmospheric who took victory, and all the competitors in the drift and concourse contests, we also celebrate those working behind the scenes to put this incredible competition together for the community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/52dd6d1ff926e397a4755ebd185da7ff3e0faa04.jpg[/img]
[i]Captured by onhellno1989: Envy Drift & PTG Street Masters Drift Championship on Forza Horizon 5.[/i]

It would not be a Year in Review without mention of the TORA 24 Hours of Mulsanne, which took place in late July. As many predicted, ESV Motorsport exerted their dominance in the event, and indeed TORA's entire endurance calendar. The record ESV carries into 2024 should strike fear into the hearts of the competition as we head into the first year of Forza Motorsport. But then again, there is nothing like a new game to mix up the pecking order!

2023 was the year of Racing Haven. While by October they already had some first events under their belts on Forza Horizon 5, it was their BMW Challenge which launched concurrently with Forza Motorsport that cemented their spot in the top echelon of the community's competitive scene. Huge congratulations to ESV Green who emerged to win from one of the largest set of entrants in recent memory. (And, as an aside, the whole community waits with bated breath for the return of the Racing Haven podcast.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/2d428c46bce46fd104def95f9822ae6e91948ddf.jpg[/img]
[i]Captured by Chilsy: Racing Haven BMW Challenge on Forza Motorsport.[/i]

As the year closes out, we catch up with events that are still ongoing! AR12 is hosting both the AR12 Community Racing Series and the AR12 Racing Championship Presented by Thrustmaster, while Late Night Racing presents a Ford v Ferrari series for lovers of vintage sports cars. There is something for everyone in the Forza community, and we can't wait to see what 2024 has in store.

[h2]Forza Motorsport[/h2]

At the start of the year, we invited our friends at Xbox to Turn 10 Studios as part of Developer_Direct to give you [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-developer-direct]a technical showcase of Forza Motorsport[/url] with a behind-the-scenes look at the cars, tracks and audio in the game. We also participated in the Xbox Games Showcase in June, [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-coming-october-10]opening pre-orders for Forza Motorsport[/url] and showcasing the [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-builders-cup]Builders Cup Career Mode[/url]. Before launch, we flew to Cologne for gamescom, demoing new gameplay to our community at an in-person theater experience. Being in Germany, it was the perfect opportunity to [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-gamescom]reveal the Nürburgring GP circuit would be available in the game[/url], with the Nordschleife coming in spring 2024.

[previewyoutube=13Qzm2qqXA4;full][/previewyoutube]
Since the release of Forza Motorsport, we've been listening to your feedback about the game and where you would like to see improvements or changes made. Stay tuned, as we’ll have more to share about these topics early in 2024.

So far, we’ve shipped two major content updates to Forza Motorsport, introducing both [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-2]Yas Marina[/url] and [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-3]Hockenheim[/url] with multiple track layouts for each, new Spotlight cars and Car Pass deliveries, and new weekly events across Career Mode, Featured Multiplayer and Rivals. [url=https://forza.net/events]You can stay up to date with the current active events in Forza Motorsport at Forza.net/Events[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/5cc5b248cb5ecb4aa9b26fe022273643f4fe2756.jpg[/img]
Recently we celebrated two wins at The Game Awards! Thanks to you, Forza Motorsport won both categories it was nominated for: Best Sports/Racing Game and Innovation in Accessibility. We’re also honored to have won [url=https://www.ign.com/articles/ign-awards-2023-every-winner-announced]IGN’s Best Racing Game of 2023[/url] and [url=https://www.ign.com/articles/accessibility-innovation-games-2023]Accessibility Innovation in Games in 2023[/url]. We love hearing about the features in the game you are enjoying, such as the Featured Multiplayer structure and driving physics, and we’re proud to have our work on [url=https://news.xbox.com/en-us/2023/04/27/forza-motorsport-accessibility-features-blind-driving/]Blind Driving Assists and the wide suite of accessibility options[/url] recognized by the gaming community. We hope you enjoy building your racing skills in Forza Motorsport for many years to come.

[h2]Forza Horizon 5[/h2]

What a year this has been to adventure through the Horizon Festival in México!

Through 12 game updates you have explored Mexico in different cars, customized your vehicles to truly make them your own, completed thrilling challenges to unlock new, exciting cars, snapped breathtaking pictures for our contests, and created the most amazing events for the community to enjoy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/911b825b874192221cca9bd72c8368054f83438c.png[/img]
We are very thankful that you chose to spend 2023 in Forza Horizon 5. Here are some of our favorite moments in the Horizon Festival.

[h3]Welcome Our Newest Expansion[/h3]

March saw the release of the second expansion that came to [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-rally-adventure-now-available]Forza Horizon 5: Rally Adventure[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/2d6ffc6aaafe8d41ae522bd77c6b9ad29542decf.jpg[/img]
Rally Adventure gave our players [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-rally-adventure-map-reveal]a completely new area to explore called Sierra Nueva[/url]. This new zone has different biomes that include sand, asphalt, jumps, inclines, forests, and more. Players were now able to enjoy racing and exploring Pueblo Artza, the Abandoned Quarry, Sand Dunes, Desert Gorge, Green Hills, and an entirely smashable Palm Forest.

To go on the perfect off-roading trip, you need the perfect off-roading vehicle, which is why Rally Adventure featured all-new rally parts for car customization as well as the anti-lag system to get those perfect starts. [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-rally-adventure]This expansion also brought 10 new-to-Horizon cars[/url] made to get a blast on the dirt, mud, and other difficult terrains.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/45be680605241ed9771601c2584aab00bf11a1a5.jpg[/img]
Rally monsters, new biomes, and an interactable environment; if you haven’t had the chance, this is your sign to close 2023 with Forza Horizon 5’s second expansion. 

[h3]New Permanent Features[/h3]

Every update we release for Forza Horizon 5 brings features we hope our players love using. We like to focus on unique themes that enhance your gameplay experience each month.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/9bda66f8a9c0dff02ed6ccaf72e3707f02c806f9.jpg[/img]
Although most updates are intended to last only for a single month, we listen to our community very closely and have made some of your favorite additions permanent.

This year, for example, the [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-summer-party]Summer Party update[/url] made the longer night cycles ([url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-midnights]introduced in Midnights at Horizon[/url]) a permanent feature. Even though they do not last as much as their original counterpart, the longer night cycle allows players to explore Mexico’s unique landscape and biomes under a different light.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/2d66d730a99058d752fbea253fb9a8823785e8dd.jpg[/img]
It’s round, it’s fast, and it’s permanent! [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-high-performance]First introduced on the High-Performance series in April[/url], the Oval Track was a huge success with our players, and we were ecstatic you enjoyed it! The Oval Track is always available to host a Road Racing event at any time.

[h3]Snapping the Perfect Year[/h3]

[url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-explore-the-horizon]Explore the Horizon was released in May of this year[/url], and with it came a feature many of our players were asking for: an upgraded Photo Mode to take front cover-worthy photos of their favorite cars in the many gorgeous backdrops Mexico has to offer.

Of course, our community of talented creators put the new features implemented in this update to good use as you can see on our many Photo Contests held on our social media accounts. We are very eager to see what you guys come up with for next year and many more to come. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/7c7f98b0765545273ef5ec869cbe8e0405deddd8.png[/img]
If you want to learn how to take advantage of the new features added to Photo Mode and upgrade your snapshooting skills, take a look at our [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-photo-guide]Forza Horizon 5 Photo Mode Guide[/url].

[h3]Fueling the Community’s Creative Spirit[/h3]

Our community members never stop creating awesome and unique events that everyone can enjoy. We have seen everything from extreme challenges, fun tours, and completely new game modes designed in EventLab. However, we wanted to step up the creation game and give you better tools to create the huge events you always dreamt of making, which is why [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-horizon-creatives]we built an entire series around inventing: Horizon Creatives[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/ee73e619c7054636062eea63f3c0a358341379d0.png[/img]
This new update put EventLab 2.0 in the hands of our creators to help with their creation process. The multi-selection mode allowed Props to be mass selected and then edited in a group. Players could grab several individual props and then rotate them, move them around, and duplicate them. You could now group props together into a new “mega prop” called a Prefab that could be easily saved, reused in your events, and shared so others could use them as well.

A new location made for creating events was also added in this update, EventLab Island provided creators with a massive blank canvas to put together larger and more exciting events and game modes.

[h3]Our Most Requested Car Makes Its Appearance[/h3]

The [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-dia-de-muertos]Día de Muertos update[/url] meant to recreate this iconic Mexican holiday and include as many references to Mexican folklore as possible. We had marigold stands and petals lying around the Festival, inflatable skulls decorating the streets, and alebrijes of many different forms to find. 

[previewyoutube=9n_2nx6ispw;full][/previewyoutube]
This celebration of Mexican culture and folklore would not be complete without Mexico’s automotive sweetheart: the 2010 Nissan Tsuru which we brought as a Festival Playlist reward car for the Día de Muertos update. 

The Tsuru, as unbelievable as it sounds, was our most requested car on the Suggestions Hub, and what a more fitting time to bring it to the Horizon Festival than Día de Muertos. 

[h3]Rolling Out the Red Carpet for Our Partnerships[/h3]

The Horizon Festival was starstruck this year, as we had the fortune of collaborating with two brands of huge relevance in automotive history. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/1190fb4cf594a7615e9ec98da6f088d3d4062a9d.jpg[/img]
The [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-upgrade-heroes]Upgrade Heroes update in July[/url] gave us the chance to be everything we wanted to be, [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-barbie]adding memorable pieces from Barbie’s history to Forza Horizon 5 as limited-time free gifts[/url]. A blast from the past came with Barbie’s pink 1956 Chevrolet Corvette. This Barbie can also go off-roading with the 2022 GMC Hummer Barbie Edition.

This December, [url=https://forza.net/news/Winter-Wonderland]we planned our next heist with the Fast X Car Pack[/url], which included five cars from Fast X including the 1970 Dodge Charger and 2022 Flip Car 2.0. You can drive these two, and three more cars from the Fast X film with the Fast X Car Pack available now for $9.99 USD.

[h2]Start the New Year with a Huge Throwback[/h2]

What better way to start the new year than with a series co-created with you! Community Choice is one of many ways we have to show how much we appreciate our fans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/0cfdd931a3abc7dd782518d6200d536fd08fc653.png[/img]
We sent out a survey asking our players what rewards, challenges, and other features they would like to see in the next series, and their response was amazing!

See us in January when Community Choice goes live featuring the highly acclaimed and requested neon decorations and Neon Cube collectible from Midnights at Horizon as well as plenty of other returning stunts, challenges and rewards on the Festival Playlist and coming to the Autoshow.

[h3]Celebrating Our Community[/h3]

The Golden Tank Awards are just around the corner!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/a980ef8ca3dfcc46cdbc0b017a7be540b6dd1fdc.png[/img]
Celebrate the magnificent creations of our community and vote for your favorite EventLab creations, Prefabs, and more content made entirely by players and for the players.

Make sure to cast your vote at [url=https://aka.ms/GoldenTankAwards2023]aka.ms/GoldenTankAwards2023[/url] and help your favorite creators take home the coveted Golden Tank Award.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/74808ad932e5752631ed376c43542b579c13a97b.png[/img]
Keep creating and we might see you in next year’s shortlist!

[h2]Thanks for Racing![/h2]

The biggest highlight we have is and always will be our amazing community. Whether you are a player, a builder, creator, event runner, or anything along those lines, we celebrate all the passion and love you have for the entire Forza franchise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/c4823fb4960cdd128a2ba9596e50e6b3c761ec7e.jpg[/img]
We hope you have enjoyed the content we put out and that you spent wonderful hours racing in the world’s most famous tracks, going on adventures around Mexico, or customizing your favorite vehicles.

[i]Keep adventuring and we’ll see you at the starting line![/i]

notes.title: This Week on Forza Motorsport: Master Hockenheim in the new free update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/5e5b01f20ff126489666769ab33a01ac48a97e9e.jpg[/img]
Hockenheim is one of the great European tracks and has seen many layout changes since its introduction in the 1930s, the last of which being designed by Hermann Tilke in 2002. The track is known for its long straights and ultra-narrow final sector.  

Start practicing and set your fastest laps on the 2.8-mile Full Circuit, the 2.3-mile National Circuit and the 1.6-mile Short Circuit in Time Attack. Hockenheim is also added to existing series in Builders Cup and Featured Multiplayer, as well as Free Play. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/126d187c2d1f6970ea6ba9ab4e42ca78f2130fc3.jpg[/img]
[h2]PLAY THE CONTEMPORARY TOUR [/h2]

Experience cutting-edge performance and innovation with unquestionably modern cars in the Contemporary Tour.  

It begins with Italian Ingenuity, a series celebrating cars blending handcrafted beauty at extraordinary speed. Experience redefined powertrains in Hybrid Ferocity, the wonders of modern aerodynamics in Tip of the Spear and conclude your journey with a modern marvel in the Valkyrie Challenge. 

Complete all 4 series in the Contemporary Tour to unlock the 6-liter V12, track-focused 2022 Pagani Huayra R, hand-built with a carbon fiber construction. 

Career Mode also has a new Open Tour featuring iconic British marques like Aston Martin, Jaguar, Lotus, and Mini. Build these cars in C, B, A, and S class series to unlock the 2015 Mclaren 650S. 

[h2]SPOTLIGHT CARS [/h2]

Your Spotlight cars for Update 3 are the 2020 Automobili Pininfarina Battista, the 2022 Ferrari 296 GTB, the 2021 McLaren Sabre, and the 2023 Aston Martin Valkyrie. Get them at a 30% discount each. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/fe5e0ec5c41e94d6d8d444d49d7f2b51a68c75ff.jpg[/img]
VIP Members can also acquire the 2018 Apollo Intensa Emozione at a 15% discount. 

[h2]MULTIPLAYER [/h2]

Compete in new online Spec Series over the next 4 weeks, including the Lotus 3-Eleven Spec Series, Formula 70s, GTP/C, and the Mazda Miata Spec Series. 

[h2]RIVALS [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/d767583013feac297d0b55d9804f932b07a32c9b.jpg[/img]
New Featured Rivals include the 2021 Mercedes-AMG One at Hockenheim Full Circuit. VIP Members can hot-lap the 2016 Mercedes-AMG C 63 S Coupé Forza Edition at Kyalami GP Circuit.

The team is constantly hard at work on bugs, some of which are not immediately visible to players but are critical for game stability for all players. 

[b]General [All Platforms] [/b]
[list]
[*]Fixes to improve overall game stability and performance across all platforms. 
[*]Saved Rivals Replays now includes weather information. [1634894] 
[*]Fixes to ray traced rendering features for ambient occlusion and mirror reflections that caused flickering and strobing effects on the car and road. [1589717]

[*]Fixed an issue with Driver Level progression not persisting after completing a Free Play event and returning to the Homespace.  [1656518] [/list]
[b]Multiplayer [All Platforms] [/b]
[list]

[*]Fixed an issue with large parties in Featured Multiplayer causing players to get into an indefinite loading screen while matchmaking. [1607503] 
[*]Fixed an issue with tire wear not being correctly applied in Private Multiplayer races. [1638983] 
[*]Fixed an issue where the Racecraft achievement to overtake 12 other players in a multiplayer race would not be unlocked despite fulfilling its requirements. [1441871] [/list]
[b]Tuning Setups [All Platforms] [/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed long load times when player attempts to save a custom upgrade or tuning setup. [1576170] 
[*]Fixed an exploit that allowed tunable part values to be edited after removing a saved tune. [1630664] 
[*]Fixed an issue in the Shared Tune Setups: Required Car Level and Required Car CP (Car Points) are inaccurate values. [1629192] [/list]
[b]Livery Editor [All Platforms] [/b]
[list]

[b]Wheels [All Platforms] [/b]
[list]

[b]Cars [All Platforms] [/b]
[list]

[*]2011 Bugatti Veyron Super Sport: Fixed issue where painting the car body changes the paint for carbon fiber elements. [1627307] 
[*]2013 Dodge SRT Viper GTS: Fixed issue where car brake caliper is seen clipping into multiple wheel rims. [1634729]
[*]2018 Honda Civic Type R: Fixed issue that displayed unnatural white texture on the car’s taillights during cinematics. [1629606]
[*]2020 KTM X-Bow GT2: Fixed an issue in which the car is using 4-cylinder engine audio while having a 5-cylinder engine. [1639286]
[*]1991 Mazda 787B: Fixed issue that caused radiator texture to be stretched in multiple locations on the car and updated audio based on community feedback. [1642967]
[*]2004 Mercedes-Benz C 32 AMG: Fixed an issue where the exhaust backfire has no audio after engine and supercharger upgrades have been installed. [1640303]
[*]2020 MG #20 MG6 XPower: Fixed issue that caused the interior of the car to reflect the driving surface under the car. [1638948][/list][i]Note: Due to the resolution of an asset streaming issue, players might notice a slight deficit in car visual fidelity during the post-race podium sequence. [/i]

[b]Accessibility [All Platforms] [/b]

[b]PC [Microsoft Store and Steam] [/b]

notes.title: Master Hockenheim in Forza Motorsport Update 3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/87fd70c56a1d63dc6ce049bba215e0478900bdef.jpg[/img]
Since the release of Forza Motorsport and [url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/21899609294227]Update 1.0[/url]
Forza Motorsport Update 3 is almost here! Master the iconic Hockenheim track, featuring 3 unique layouts for you to race, and several Spotlight cars that are ready to be put to the test in the Career Mode Contemporary Tour, new Featured Multiplayer series and Rivals events. 

Update 3 will be live in the game for 5 weeks before Update 4 releases in mid-January. 

[h2]Game Fixes and Release Notes [/h2] 

Update 3 will be available to download on Xbox Series X|S, Windows PCs and Steam starting early next week. Live content will begin to light up across the Career, Featured Multiplayer and Rivals from December 14, 2023. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/1125144b8d57a87e4a58af458675df9fcaf59289.jpg[/img]
New fixes coming in Update 3 will continue to improve the overall stability and performance of the game, alleviating some of the issues we're seeing players report most frequently on our community channels. The team is constantly hard at work on bugs, some of which are not immediately visible to players but are critical for game stability for all players. 

Below you can find the highlights of what will be fixed or improved upon in Update 3. [url= https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/sections/21456569521683-Release-Notes-and-Known-Issues]We’ll share the full release notes next week on the Forza Support website[/url] once the update rolls out. 

[list] 
[*]Fixed issue in which the Driver Level visually appeared to reset to Level 1 after downloading Update 2 and entering Test Drive in Free Play. 
[*]Rebalanced the impact on front and rear downforce when being drafted by another car.   
[*][strike]Fixed issue causing custom wheel input layouts to reset to their default settings after relaunching the game with both a controller and steering wheel connected to the PC or console.   [/strike]
[b]Editor's Note: [/b]While we intended to release this improvement as part of Update 3, we have realized that additional time to implement and test the fix is required. It will instead be introduced to Forza Motorsport in a future update.
[*]Fixed issue which allowed players to sell their Builders Cup reward cars, preventing them from reobtaining the cars and completing their associated Reward Showcases. [/list] 
We continue to put a focus on raising our overall quality on PC, as we know we have more work to do there. Here are some of the PC-specific improvements coming in Update 3: 

[list] 
[*]Stability and performance are improved on lower spec PCs. 
[*]Fixed various random crashes in multiplayer races specifically on PCs with AMD GPUs. 
[*]Reduced the occurrence of a bug where the track or other objects becomes invisible while racing. [/list] 
We’ve also introduced new options in the Screen Narrator section of the Accessibility settings menu to narrate your race position and driver names ahead and behind you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/c0cf6cd5d895dcdcee30fef6599c07d4a58f40b1.jpg[/img]
[h2]New Track – Hockenheim [/h2] 

Known for its long straights and ultra-narrow final sector, Hockenheim is one of the great European tracks and has seen many layout changes since its introduction in the 1930s, the last of which being designed by Hermann Tilke in 2002. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/5e5b01f20ff126489666769ab33a01ac48a97e9e.jpg[/img]
Forza Motorsport has 3 Hockenheim track layouts available for you to play across Career Mode, Multiplayer, Free Play and Rivals. Set your fastest laps on the 2.8-mile Full Circuit, the 2.3-mile National Circuit and the 1.6-mile Short Circuit. Master all 3 layouts using your favorite car builds in Time Attack with leaderboards available for all car classes in the game. 

[h2]New Race Suits [/h2] 

Level up and suit up for the grid! Forza Motorsport Update 3 introduces 33 new driver suits to the Driver Customization menu. Groups of suits will unlock at Driver Level milestones 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, and 100. Level up and unlock some unique looks that you can use to show up to the grid in style.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/4054eae57b8027f253270598bf7d5c79efc6ea5c.jpg[/img]
If you’ve already surpassed these Driver Levels, all the new suits will be retroactively unlocked for you once the update is available. Please note, a game restart may be required for all suits to be downloaded and unlocked. 

[h2]New Career Series – Contemporary Tour [/h2] 

Experience cutting-edge performance and innovation with unquestionably modern cars in the Contemporary Tour.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/ec8699b52358cf2d1b1166a2db109cc247cf704f.jpg[/img]
The new Featured Tour begins with Italian Ingenuity, a series celebrating cars blending handcrafted beauty at extraordinary speed. From there you will experience the redefinition of powertrains as the potential of hybridization is geared towards performance rather than economy in the Hybrid Ferocity series.  

In the following week, celebrate the wonders of modern aerodynamics in the Tip of The Spear series and race cars that have spent as much time in wind tunnels as state-of-the-art aircraft. Finally, conclude your journey with a modern marvel in the Valkyrie Challenge, a car which has pushed the boundaries of car design to the absolute edge. 

[table]
[tr][th][b]Italian Ingenuity [/b][/th][th][b]December 14, 2023 [/b][/th][th][b]2020 Automobili Pininfarina Battista [/b][/th][/tr]
[tr][td]Hybrid Ferocity [/td][td]December 21, 2023 [/td][td]2022 Ferrari 296 GTB [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Tip of The Spear [/td][td]December 28, 2023 [/td][td]2021 McLaren Sabre [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Valkyrie Challenge [/td][td]January 4, 2024 [/td][td]2023 Aston Martin Valkyrie [/td][/tr]
[/table]
 
Contemporary Tour series do not have to be completed in a particular week – you have until January 31, 2024, to finish this latest Featured Tour. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/28da2ccd2e39d37a28c1190552400142fc2ce1f5.jpg[/img]
Complete all 4 series in the Contemporary Tour to unlock the 6-liter V12, track-focused 2022 Pagani Huayra R, hand-built with a carbon fiber construction. 

[h2]New Career Series – British Marques Open Tour [/h2] 

With each update to Forza Motorsport, the Open Tour gets refreshed with new events and a new reward car.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/9dab9e58aa3257a28572da837fa9b6d56534537f.jpg[/img]
Open Tour is where you can continue the journey of your favorite cars. Cars that you’ve already built in a different Builders Cup series can be further levelled up and upgraded in the Open Tour.  

In Update 3, the Open Tour will see you bring your favorite cars to take on iconic British marques. Drivatars will be using cars from Aston Martin, Jaguar, Lotus, and Mini. You are not restricted to any of these manufacturers, so you can compete with the cars you enjoy the most. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/7870ef723b299eafa186ff224e92080bf89d280a.jpg[/img]
All 4 refreshed Open Tour series (C, B, A, S) will be available on December 14. Complete all 4 series before January 18, 2024, to unlock the 2015 Mclaren 650S. 

[h2]New Featured Multiplayer Series – Spec and Open Events [/h2] 

Here’s a look at the Featured Multiplayer calendar for Update 3: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/52a36e8f8009bd3424bdc6ae500ca2accb9f22e7.jpg[/img]
[table]

[tr][td]Vintage Le Mans Prototype Series [/td][td]P Class [/td][td]2015 Lamborghini #63 Squadra Corse Huracán LP620-2 Super Trofeo [/td][td]January 11-18 [/td][/tr]

[tr][td]Online Adventure [/td][td]Series 68 [/td][td]Qualify for the Online Adventure Roster [/td][td]Festival Playlist Completion [/td][/tr]
[/table]

The 3-Eleven is an open-cockpit, mid-engine screamer that exemplifies Lotus founder Colin Chapman’s mantra “simplify, then add lightness.” 

[h3]Formula 70s Series – December 21-28 [/h3] 

The 1970s Golden Era of formula racing brought iconic wings and aerodynamic effects to help drivers control an escalating horsepower war between teams. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/1a71048a09ec25d60f211d24e8413a5c346905f7.jpg[/img]
[h3]GTP/C Series – December 28-January 4 [/h3] 

GTP Group C cars were at the pinnacle of endurance racing design in the 1980s and 90s, combining fuel saving aerodynamics with enormous horsepower that set speed records still standing today. 

[h3]Mazda Miata Spec Series – January 4-11 [/h3] 

The popular MX5 ‘94 version of the best-selling Mazda Miata is perfectly balanced to handle the most demanding road courses with the speed and agility of cars costing much, much more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/028214affa52270b20eaf6632019d4ba395d77b6.jpg[/img]
[h3]Vintage Le Mans Prototype Series – January 11-18 [/h3] 

Reignite Le Mans’ greatest rivalries racing the most recognizable, most dominant cars of the 1960s and early 70s. 

[h2]Featured Rivals – Update 3 Calendar [/h2] 

Challenge your skills across 4 new Featured Rivals highlighting a Spotlight car every week, as well as a special event on Hockenheim Full Circuit featuring the 2021 Mercedes-AMG ONE. This performance hybrid is the ideal car to take on the long straights at Hockenheim as it produces beyond 1,000 horsepower at a maximum speed of over 350 km/h (217 miles). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/d00381832ee15926267a477fd8c3dbb457905114.jpg[/img]
Meanwhile if you have VIP Membership, check out the 2016 Mercedes-AMG C 63 S Coupé Forza Edition at Kyalami GP Circuit. 

Update 3 also means the beginning of Stage 2 of the Logitech McLaren G Challenge. Sign up at Discord.gg/LogitechG to qualify for prizes, including a chance to win a VIP racing experience with McLaren! 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/f65519887f730f3c857f6768ad4709a49b228ce0.jpg[/img]
Once registered, set your fastest laps at Hakone in the 2021 McLaren 765LT Coupe. The top drivers per region advance to the semifinals in February 2024.

notes.title: Race Yas Marina in Forza Motorsport Update 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/63273d69dca98ebaf0d2da47397263ca0976eaf0.jpg[/img]
Today on Forza Monthly we introduced you to Forza Motorsport Update 2, featuring new Spotlight cars to race in the Prestige Tour and our first post-release track, Yas Marina, with 4 unique layouts for you to master.

Live content can be enjoyed in a variety of ways in Forza Motorsport, from Career mode to Featured Multiplayer and Rivals. We’ll have new events lighting up in these areas of the game accompanying each game update.

[h2]Game Fixes and Release Notes[/h2]

Like we do for Forza Horizon 5 updates, we’ll start with some of the notable fixes and improvements you can look forward to in this Forza Motorsport update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/fea4aefd422e856c3eaad26face96859358ba75c.jpg[/img]
Below you can find the highlights of what will be fixed or improved upon in Update 2 based on the reports we’re reading from you. We’ll share the full release notes on November 14 once the update begins rolling out for download.

[h2]Stability[/h2]
[list]
[*]Many fixes to improve overall game stability and reduce crashes across all platforms.
[*]Livery Editor
[*]Fixed issue where players can view and unlock tunes and vinyls shared by other players.
[*]Fixed issue causing black paint shade to show up as grey instead of black.
[*]Fixed issue where only the inner barrel on factory rims is paintable.[/list]

[h2]PC[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue requiring shaders to recompile every time Forza Motorsport is started on AMD chipsets.
[*]Fixed specific game crash that occurs if headphones are plugged into the front panel.[/list]

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixes to matchmaking as a group, party management, and invites and joins across multiplayer.
[*]Fixes to ensure custom liveries show up more consistently across multiplayer game modes.
[*]Fixes to address cases where Intermission/Launch Countdown would take much longer than expected before the start of multiplayer races.
[*]Fixes to automatic wet tire selection when entering an event, and fixes to fuel estimation logic.
[*]Fixes to title stability when resuming from a suspended state on console.
[*]Fixed issue in the Featured Multiplayer menu where countdown timer would appear on Series that had not yet started.
[*]Adjusted event schedule to provide more variation in Event start times.
[*]Fixed issue where Race End timer did not appear for players who had already finished the race.[/list]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where players could encounter an infinite loading screen when saving a Quick Upgrade in the Builders Cup Career Mode.
[*]Resolved an exploit related to changing car tune mid-race.
[*]Fixed issue where the game becomes stuck in the “new content update” loop when entering the main menu.
[*]Fixes to Replays in scenarios where Replays do not start playing, the cars do not move, or they float.
[*]Fixed issue with a forced camera change at the start of a race.
[*]Fixed a number of Builders Cup Exploit allowing high class cars into lower class series and events.
[*]Fixed issues related to loss of progression or save data.
[*]Fixed a number of visual scene transitions
[*]Fixed a bug where replaying a series with a high standing didn’t replace the series trophy with the improved trophy. [/list]

[h2]Cars[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue with the 2018 Porsche 718 Cayman GTS Sport Roll Cage visual upgrade option, which removes the roof of the car when viewed in first-person.
[*]Fixed tuning stat comparison indicators within the car upgrades menu[/list]

[h2]Wheels[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue that prevented the Thrustmaster T248 LED screen from displaying race position information.[/list]

New updates will continue to introduce further fixes and improvements to Forza Motorsport. You can find the list of items we are currently investigating in [url=http://aka.ms/FMKnownIssues]our Known Issues tracker[/url]. Help our team to reproduce and fix the issues you’re experiencing in Forza Motorsport by [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]reporting them in our Forza Troubleshooting Hub[/url].

[h2]New Track – Yas Marina Circuit[/h2]

As one of the most technologically advanced tracks ever constructed, Yas Marina is a modern marvel, seamlessly blending cutting-edge architecture with thrilling racing and the shimmering waters of Adu Dhabi.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/6d5146f9c7972e7f8ee607b91bf18bce45b29260.jpg[/img]
Yas Marina has been rebuilt for Forza Motorsport with its up-to-date race season layout, which includes a more flowing hairpin for better racing and overtaking opportunities. The track, located in Abu Dhabi, has 4 unique layouts for you to master: the 3.28-mile Full Circuit, the North Corkscrew, the North Circuit and the South Circuit. Set your fastest lap time on each layout using your favorite car builds in Time Attack with leaderboards available for all car classes in Forza Motorsport.

We’ve also refreshed some existing Tours of Motorsport in the Builders Cup to feature the new Yas Marina layouts, including Built for Sport, Premium Performance, C8 Challenge and S Class Open Series. You’ll also get to experience the track in the new Prestige Tour, as well as the Forza GT and Forza Touring Car Spec Series in Featured Multiplayer, and Featured Rivals events.

[h2]Spotlight Cars – Update 2[/h2]

Get ready to expand your garage at a discount. New Spotlight cars are featured in the Showroom every week, available for you to acquire with a 30% discount using in-game credits. These cars can be used in the Prestige Tour, as well as Spotlight Series events in Featured Multiplayer and Rivals.

[/table]
VIP Members also receive an exclusive 15% discount on the 2019 Ferrari Monza SP2 from November 16 until December 13.

[h2]Fresh Car Pass Drops – Update 2[/h2]

Here is your Forza Motorsport Car Pass calendar for the next 4 weeks:

[table]
[tr][th][b]CAR PASS CAR[/b][/th][th][b]RELEASE[/b][/th][/tr]

[/table]
Car Pass includes 30 new-to-Motorsport cars with one released every week until Car Pass is complete. Get Car Pass today in the Forza Motorsport Deluxe and Premium Editions.

[h2]New Career Series – Prestige Tour[/h2]

Prestige is something that must be earned, combining elusive, elegant quality with unmatched performance, technical innovation and a storied heritage. These are the dream cars of every automotive enthusiast, evoking emotions like wonder and awe in their drivers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/afdad207fc7da2a991bd49d940404dd9a25e7742.jpg[/img]
The Prestige Tour begins with the British GT Series, an exploration of the famous marques that have made the country so famous in the automotive space. It continues with the V12 Power Series where you’ll experience the power and harmony of mighty V12 engines in some of the most elusive cars of the past 20 years. You’re then invited to take on the fastest production cars ever made in the Maximum Velocity Series before finally discovering the world of limited-production supercars in the Boutique Builds Series, blending art with performance like nothing else on the track.

[table]
[tr][th][b]PRESTIGE TOUR[/b][/th][th][b]STARTS[/b][/th][th][b]SPOTLIGHT CARS[/b][/th][/tr]

[tr][td]Boutique Builds Series[/td][td]December 7, 2023[/td][td]2017 Saleen S7 LM, 2016 Spania GTA Spano, 2022 Gordon Murray Automotive T.50[/td][/tr]
[/table]
These series do not have to be completed in a particular week – you have until December 28, 2023, to complete the Prestige Tour, so you can enjoy these events at your own pace.

Complete all 4 Prestige Tour series to unlock a car that requires no introduction, the 2011 Lamborghini Sesto Elemento. You will be rewarded with this car regardless of how you finish in each race or the overall series.

[h2]New Career Series – Italian Open Tour[/h2]

For Update 2, the Builders Cup Open Class Tour celebrates Italian manufacturers. Build and compete against iconic marques like Lamborghini, Maserati, and Ferrari on the racetrack to claim the coveted 2015 Ferrari 488 GTB.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/4fd6078d7d63b4100a30d49c99b74b7c748e7021.jpg[/img]
All 4 Open Tour series (C, B, A, S) will be available on November 16. You have until December 14, 2023, to complete this series.

[h2]New Featured Multiplayer Series – Spec and Open Events[/h2]

Here’s a look at the Featured Multiplayer calendar for Update 2:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/64013db41237d5f28741ecf45ae7605a81463fa7.jpg[/img]
[h3]Vintage Le Mans Sportscars – November 16-22[/h3]

Race legendary cars that are as beautiful as they are brutal. Only the bravest and most skilled drivers can handle these classic racers at the limit.

[h3]Subaru BRZ Spec Series – November 23-29[/h3]

Take part in a true test of driver skill in a handling masterclass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/4aac6d315d6bf247ebe36b1bf0d8b02041e91b2c.jpg[/img]
[h3]The Birth of Grand Prix – November 9-December 6[/h3]

Discover classic open wheel racers that epitomized the pioneering spirit of motorsport.

[h3]Forza P2 Series – December 7-13[/h3]

Race to the limit and compete for the podium in one of the most competitive classes in motorsport.

[h3]Featured Rivals – Update 2 Calendar[/h3]

Challenge your skills across 5 new Featured Rivals highlighting a Spotlight car every week, as well as a special event on Yas Marina Full Circuit, featuring an equally luxurious car, the 2020 Koenigsegg Jesko. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/35e1660949a892983da9393bc07f03466b7ffef5.jpg[/img]
VIP Members can also look forward to a monthly-long event featuring the 2019 Veloster N Forza Edition on Lime Rock Full Circuit Alt.

notes.title: Forza Motorsport Community Update 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/9706f723da084d968bcc3a8ed23c50928e56297f.jpg[/img]
Since the release of Forza Motorsport and [url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/21899609294227]Update 1.0[/url], we’ve been working on additional fixes and improvements to the game based on the top reported issues in the community. We understand how frustrating these are, especially when they may hinder your full enjoyment of the game, and we intend to resolve them as soon as possible. 

We are committed to supporting Forza Motorsport in the long term by delivering monthly content updates and quality-of-life improvements. Update 2 is our first content update for the game and it’s coming mid-November, introducing an additional track location, Yas Marina. We also have over 200 fixes lined up for this release, including improvements for these highly reported issues: 

[h3]Stability [/h3]
[list]
[*]Many fixes to improve overall game stability and reduce crashes across all platforms. [/list]
[h3]Livery Editor [/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue where players can view and unlock tunes and vinyls shared by other players. 
[*]Fixed issue causing black paint shade to show up as grey instead of black. 
[*]Fixed issue where only the inner barrel on factory rims is paintable.[/list]
[h3]PC [/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue requiring shaders to recompile every time Forza Motorsport is started on AMD chipsets. 
[*]Fixed specific game crash that occurs if headphones are plugged into the front panel. [/list][i]Note – PC players using AMD 7900 XTX who encounter a crash at the end of races should download the latest AMD graphics driver to resolve this issue. [/i]

[h3]Multiplayer [/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixes to matchmaking as a group, party management, and invites and joins across multiplayer. 
[*]Fixes to ensure custom liveries show up more consistently across multiplayer game modes. 
[*]Fixes to address cases where Intermission/Launch Countdown would take much longer than expected before the start of multiplayer races. 
[*]Fixes to automatic wet tire selection when entering an event, and fixes to fuel estimation logic. 
[*]Fixes to title stability when resuming from a suspended state on console. [/list]
[h3]Gameplay [/h3]
[list]
[*]Resolved an exploit related to changing car tune mid-race. 
[*]Fixed issue where the game becomes stuck in the “new content update” loop when entering the main menu. 
[*]Fixes to Replays in scenarios where Replays do not start playing, the cars do not move, or they float. 
[*]Fixed issue with a forced camera change at the start of a race. [/list]
[h3]Cars [/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue with the 2018 Porsche 718 Cayman GTS Sport Roll Cage visual upgrade option, which removes the roof of the car when viewed in first-person. [/list]
[h3]Wheels [/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue that prevented the Thrustmaster T248 LED screen from displaying race position information.[/list]
Stability is an area that we’ll continue to work on beyond Update 2 with additional improvements coming to Forza Motorsport in future updates.  

We’re aware that the infinite loading screen when saving a Quick Upgrade in the Builders Cup still occurs for some players after the Update 1.1 hotfix. We’re investigating this issue very carefully, and with the additional information that we have received from the community, we believe we have identified the root cause. We hope to better resolve this issue soon. 

Thank you for your continued patience as we work to resolve these issues. [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Please continue sharing your bug reports with us on the Troubleshooting Hub[/url]. Including details such as reproduction steps can help us to identify and resolve issues more quickly. Continuing to submit your game content suggestions in [url=http://aka.ms/SHUB]the Suggestion Hub[/url] will help shape our future content updates. 

We will share more details about the new content additions in Update 2, as well as the full list of fixes and improvements, closer to its release in November, and we’ll let you know once those changes begin to roll out.

notes.title: Forza Motorsport Update 1.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/18b0980cf8605e00a86f6555869aae0e5167d7a4.jpg[/img]
We're working to improve your Forza Motorsport experience. Below you will find a summary of items fixed or improved upon in Update 1.0.

For full release notes including Xbox changes see: https://aka.ms/FMUpdate1

[h3]Stability [All Platforms][/h3]
[list]
[*]General stability improvements with fixes for various crash scenarios. 
[*]Fixed a crash that could occur in the Builders Cup Career Mode after upgrading a car and entering Open Practice in the Fox Body Challenge race on Watkins Glen. 
[*]Fixed a crash that could occur on Grand Oak Club Circuit during a cinematic when entering Open Practice for the third race of the Builders Cup Intro Series. 
[*]Fixed a crash that could occur when entering a Free Play race from the My Cars menu if there were too many cars with custom thumbnail images. 
[*]Fixed a crash that could occur upon loading into a Free Play race.  [/list]
[h3]Progression [All Platforms] [/h3]
[list]
[*]Adjusted car part unlock levels to increase player upgrade options at lower car levels. Most car parts should now be unlocked within a single Builders Cup series. 
[*]Improvements to ensure Car Affinity manufacturer reward discounts are unlocked when intended – once a player reaches Car Level 50 in a car from the respective brand. [/list]
[h3]Multiplayer [All Platforms] [/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an exploit in Featured Multiplayer where in specific scenarios, a player could post impossible lap times onto the Qualifying leaderboard by entering Qualifying directly from a Practice session.  
[*]Resolved an issue where at times incorrect Safety Rating and Driver Skill Ratings were used for matchmaking. 
[*]Fixed an issue where control of the car wouldn’t be handed back to the player upon exiting the pits in Featured Multiplayer and beginning a solo race in Free Play. 
[*]Fixed an issue that prevented players from downloading and saving another player’s livery while in a Private Multiplayer pre-race. [/list]
[h3]Livery Editor [All Platforms] [/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue on the 2016 Ford #66 Ford Racing GT Le Mans while moving a decal around the “Top” or “Hood” of the vehicle while in the Livery Editor which caused decals to appear reflected and offset on the other side of the car. 
[*]Fixed an issue on the 2018 Porsche 911 GT2 RS where stripe decals would not correctly line-up between the hood, roof and wing. 
[*]Fixed a crash encountered in Apply Decals when importing a Layer Group from a previous Forza game and then attempting to apply a Vinyl Shape. [/list]
[h3]Tracks [All Platforms] [/h3]
[list]
[*]Updated trackside flag textures on Indianapolis Motor Speedway. 
[*]Fixed an issue on Le Mans track layouts where a specific curb would stop LMP cars as if they were colliding with an invisible wall. [/list]
[h3]Physics [All Platforms] [/h3]
[list]
[*]Improved wet tire wear rates in conditions where track wetness levels are moderate. Wet tires will still wear quickly in dry or semi-dry conditions. 
[*]Tuning Setup [All Platforms] 
[*]Fixed an issue that prevented players from downloading another player’s custom Tuning Setup while browsing a Leaderboard. [/list]
[h3]Accessibility [All Platforms] [/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where custom key binds for a controller or keyboard would not be saved between game sessions. [/list]
[h3]Accessibility [Steam Only] [/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the speech-to-text window did not appear when speech-to-text or text-to-speech would be enabled. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the speech-to-text or text-to-speech window would persist on-screen for an indefinite duration until the game was relaunched.  [/list]
[h3]Replay [All Platforms] [/h3]
[list]
[*]Improved the visuals of the replay camera shown for the last segment of VIR Grand West. [/list]
[h3]Cars [All Platforms] [/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with the 1956 Jaguar D-Type where cockpit view would appear too low and clip through the driver’s collar. 
[*]Fixed an issue with the Alfa Romeo Giuletta Quadrifoglio Verde where the front of the car disappeared after selecting a front bumper visual upgrade. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the 2014 Volkswagen Golf R side skirts could not be seen after installing a bodykit. 
[*]Fixed an issue with the 1977 Holden Torana where both Street and Sport Roll Cages would be visibly present on the car after installing a Race Roll Cage.
[*]Removed visible graining on the 2021 Lexus LC 500 Race Roll Cage texture. 
[*]Fixed an issue with the 2004 Porsche 911 GT3, 1997 Nissan Skyline GT-R V-Spec, 2018 Renault Megane R.S. and 2012 MINI John Cooper Works GP where higher-level Roll Cage would be visible on lower-level upgrades. 
[*]Fixed an issue with the 2021 BMW M3 where the RPM displayed on the digital dash would be desynced with the RPM shown on the Forza UI HUD. 
[*]Fixed ambient occlusion errors on both the exterior and interior views in the 2016 Cadillac ATS-V and fixed a separate issue of damage geometry clipping when viewing the car from a distance. 
[*]Fixed an issue with the 2014 Lamborghini Huracan where no light is cast from the car gauge and dashboard cluster, as well as the headlights, taillights and brake lights. We’ve also fixed ambient occlusion errors on this vehicle. 
[*]Updated the mirror texture of the 2018 SUBARU #1 Adrian Flux SUBARU Racing Levorg GT from a repeating pattern to its intended semi-gloss metallic silver texture. 
[*]Fixed an issue with the 2020 Chevrolet C8 Corvette Stingray where using the Remove Wing Upgrade left the Stock Wing visible on the car. 
[*]Fixed an odd behavior scenario that would occur for players who own the Forza Motorsport Premium Edition or Premium Add-Ons Bundle on both Xbox and Steam and use the same Gamertag on both versions where duplicated DLC cars would result in an error message prompting the player to repurchase the associated DLC. 
[*]Fixed an exploit where DLC car duplicates purchased from the Showroom could be used on another account or platform where the DLC has not been purchased. [/list]

notes.title: Forza Motorsport Community Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/37d1422c0d39f3a5d5c27dd2489fe58cb6e3b2b2.jpg[/img]
Hi everyone. It’s been a week since Forza Motorsport released for Premium Edition owners and, in that time, we’ve been reading your feedback and listening to your concerns. Forza Motorsport has been designed to be a racing platform that will change and adapt over time. This includes tweaks to the gameplay systems, features and quality of life improvements, as well as new content that will be introduced every month. 

Ever since players got their hands on Forza Motorsport, the team has continued developing new fixes and is committed to ongoing improvements, some of which will be released as early as next week. Stay tuned for the details and full release notes on [url=http://aka.ms/FMGetStarted]our Forza Support website[/url] and Forza Motorsport channels. 

While this first update focuses on quality of life and stability issues, we look forward to continuing to listen to, and evaluate, our players' feedback in future updates. 

Thanks to all our players for being part of the Forza Motorsport community and for your continued support and patience. We will keep you updated on when those changes start to roll out. 

We’re excited to shape the future of Forza Motorsport together. [url=http://aka.ms/SHUB]Share your input and tell us about your experiences with the game on the official Forza Suggestions Hub[/url].

notes.title: Forza Motorsport Now Available on Steam
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/e0ab552198b215d8b20e43376503aa60bf559bcf.jpg[/img]
Today is an exciting day for all of us here at Turn 10 Studios as Forza Motorsport is now officially available worldwide on Steam.

Forza Motorsport introduces the [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-builders-cup]car building focused Builders Cup Career Mode[/url] for single-player racers and [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-multiplayer]a race weekend-structured Featured Multiplayer[/url] for online competition. There’s also Free Play to create your own races using the more than 500 cars and 20 tracks in the game, and Rivals with Time Attack where you can rise the global leaderboard. 

[previewyoutube=13Qzm2qqXA4;full][/previewyoutube]
Start your racing career in Forza Motorsport by selecting one of the below bundles, each of which will allow you to build new skills and hone your race craft through competition: 

[h2]Forza Motorsport Standard Edition[/h2] 

Immerse yourself in over 500 real cars across 20 world-famous tracks, including fan favorite locations and multiple track layouts, each featuring fully dynamic time-of-day with weather and unique driving conditions.  

Out-build the competition using more than 800 performance upgrades in the all-new, fun and rewarding single-player experience, the Builders Cup Career Mode.  

Race alongside your friends in adjudicated multiplayer events with tire and fuel strategy, a race weekend inspired structure and new driver and safety ratings.  

Compete with cutting edge AI opponents, advanced physics, powerful assists, new damage and dirt accumulation systems and photorealistic visuals with real-time ray tracing on-track. 
[list] 
[*]Includes the full game [/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/13a6432bde8c991bb29c1a98ea7a1ab1a6e3d7ab.png[/img]
[h2]Forza Motorsport Deluxe Edition[/h2] 
[list] 
[*]Includes the full game 
[*]Car Pass [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/3cb0f44fa9d9adf0467363bbbf5f7324f01d182b.png[/img]
[h2]Forza Motorsport Premium Edition[/h2]
[list]
[*]Includes the full game 
[*]Race Day Car Pack 
[*]Car Pass 
[*]VIP Membership 
[*]Welcome Pack [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/2f4fbb0b69ae0e0f2372676b35207f4e617320b1.png[/img]

Below you can check out our calendar of the first 6 Car Pass cars coming soon to Forza Motorsport. [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-early-access]You can learn more about the cars and bonuses included in the Race Day Car Pack, VIP Membership, and Welcome Pack in our previous blog[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/3173bca9555262f40e0b5c7bc0d3043a4fd4d74e.jpg[/img]
Any issues that you encounter while playing Forza Motorsport should be [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]reported on the official Troubleshooting Hub[/url]. If you have any ideas for future cars, tracks or gameplay features, [url=http://aka.ms/SHUB]let us know on the Suggestions Hub[/url]. We’ve also [url=http://aka.ms/FMGetStarted]updated our Forza Support site[/url] with a host of new resources to help you get started with the game, including a [url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/21456702310931-Known-Issues-Forza-Motorsport]Known Issues tracker[/url] which will be frequently updated. 

[h2]Live Content[/h2]

Forza Motorsport will expand over time as our evolving racing platform – [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-evolving-racing-platform]check out this blog for more details on what to expect in October and the months ahead[/url], including new cars and tracks, as well as limited-time single-player and multiplayer events. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/fb5575e39c7bbb164fbd0c9d179a2ced78db50ac.jpg[/img]
The first Featured Tour in Forza Motorsport is the Track Tour, showcasing different varieties of cars built for competition on the track. Each week there will be a new series of races featuring different types of track cars, including our Spotlight cars.  

Look out for the 2022 Subaru BRZ in Track Day available now, the 2020 KTM X-Bow GT2 in Built to Race available starting October 12, the 2014 Ferrari FXX K in Track Exotics available starting October 19, and the 2019 Ginetta #6 Team LNT Ginetta G60-LT-P1 in Prototype Power available starting October 26. Complete all four series in the Track Tour to unlock the 2020 Acura #6 ARX-05 DPi. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/c0ab51abc07255f6b0c06cef20b13d6757f92818.jpg[/img]
Meanwhile, in Featured Multiplayer, there will be a new Spec Series rotating every week. For October, these include GTX Sportscars, Formula Mazda, Early LMP and Early Factory Racecars. There will also be a separate weekly series highlighting the new Spotlight cars. 

Also, if you’re looking to bring your favorite upgraded cars into both Career Mode and Featured Multiplayer, check out the Open Tour and Open Class Series, respectively. In October, the Open Tour celebrates German manufacturers, while the online Open Class Series allows you to bring the upgraded car of your choice within the designated class. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/c082f291296e57a62e63311194908521c9c258b7.jpg[/img]
Over in Featured Rivals, put the Spotlight cars to the test by setting your fastest lap times on the leaderboards! You will also find a welcome event featuring the 2024 Chevrolet Corvette E-Ray on Maple Valley - Full Circuit and a special VIP-exclusive event with the 2020 Corvette Stingray Coupe Forza Edition on Laguna Seca - Full Circuit. 

Want to know more about Forza Motorsport? Check out the blogs below exploring the new single-player and multiplayer modes, physics advancements and features in the game, as well as our car and track lists. 
[list] 
[*][url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-builders-cup]Discover Forza Motorsport’s New Car Building Career[/url] 
[*][url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-drivatars-tire-physics]Forza Motorsport’s New AI and Physics Make Every Race Competitive[/url]

[*][url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-gamescom]Forza Motorsport Unveils Iconic Nürburgring GP and PC Specs at gamescom[/url] 
[*][url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-preview]Forza Motorsport is the Competitive Ground for Building Skill[/url] 
[*][url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-achievements]Forza Motorsport Preloads and Achievements Reveal[/url] 
[*][url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-car-list]Forza Motorsport Initial Car List[/url] 
[*][url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-track-list]Forza Motorsport Initial Track List[/url][/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/a3fb4b88ff50a3243d658478921d1ab34f2af097.jpg[/img]
On behalf of everyone at Turn 10 Studios, thank you for your support. We can’t wait to see you at the starting line!
